entries: You have a {@variantrule Swim Speed|XPHB} equal to your walking speed.

subclassFeature.name: Relentless Juggernaut
entries: You can take the {@action Dash|XPHB} action as part of the {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} you use to Rage, and as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on subsequent turns while Raging. Additionally, when you take the {@action Dash|XPHB} action, you ignore {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}, and if moving through {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} would cause you to take damage, such as from {@spell Spike Growth|XPHB}, you are immune to that damage. These benefits last until the end of the turn.

subclassFeature.name: Walking Fortress
entries: You have mastered the art of modifying your Heavy Armour, making you a true walking fortress. When you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, choose one of the following modifications to add to your armour, which remains active until you use this feature again to choose another.

items.name: Elementally Abjured
entries: You resist Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, and Poison damage while you are wearing your armour.

items.name: Extensive Customisation
entries: Choose two modifications from your Modified Armour feature. You gain them in addition to those granted by that feature.

items.name: No Weak Points
entries: Attack rolls can't be made at {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} against you while you are wearing your armour and aren't {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Oath of Wild Magic
entries: The Oath of Wild Magic is a vow to embrace and uphold the fundamental nature of magic. To synchronise one's spirit with the song of free magic that dances through the realms, to allow the chaos of unpredictable forces to guide you, to guide them in turn without demanding control, these are the ways of the Oath of Wild Magic.

In practice, such philosophy manifests as ideals of freedom, honesty, and impermanence. Many Wild Magic Paladins often serve as councilors and ambassadors to magical beings like dragons and archmages, or as guardians of sacred, magical places. Few Paladins of this order submit to hierarchy, however, valuing their own freedom as well as that of the common folk. Others who swear this oath have no such lofty, anarchistic ideals, and do so simply to embrace the honest, unpredictable magic that permeates all things.

entries.name: Tenets of Wild Magic
entries: The Tenets of Wild Magic are less rigid than those of other paladin orders, serving as philosophical guidelines rather than an immutable code.

items.name: Impermanence
entries: Nothing lasts forever. One day everything will end, and no-one will remember. Seek not to preserve the ways of old, embrace change and spontaneity.

items.name: Freedom
entries: Bare not shackles of iron or philosophy. The magic of the world cannot truly be captured or owned. As manifestations of that magic, the same applies to all living things.

items.name: Honesty
entries: Divine Magic is a fundamental force of existence. Like gravity, it cannot lie. You should be the same. Hide nothing; speak openly; seek not to control others with deception.

items.name: Humility
entries: Stake no claim to the forces or form you wield. Your strength of body and magic are temporary gifts, not rights. They will fade in time. Be thankful, and command them with respect.

subclassFeature.name: Oath Spells
entries: You gain Oath Spells at the Paladin Levels listed.

entries.caption: Oath Spells
rows: {@spell Disguise Self|XPHB} and one randomly determined 1st level spell from the {@filter Sorcerer spell list|spells|class=Sorcerer}
{@spell Levitate|XPHB} and one randomly determined 2nd level spell from the {@filter Sorcerer spell list|spells|class=Sorcerer}
{@spell Major Image|XPHB} and one randomly determined 3rd level spell from the {@filter Sorcerer spell list|spells|class=Sorcerer}
{@spell Hallucinatory Terrain|XPHB} and one randomly determined 4th level spell from the {@filter Sorcerer spell list|spells|class=Sorcerer}
{@spell Legend Lore|XPHB} and one randomly determined 5th level spell from the {@filter Sorcerer spell list|spells|class=Sorcerer}

subclassFeature.name: Channel Divinity
entries: You gain the following Channel Divinity options.

items.name: Well of Magic
entries: You draw upon the latent magic of the world to empower yourself. Over the course of a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}, you regain expended spell slots. The spell slots can have a combined level of up to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} (for example, at level 5 you could regain one 2nd level spell and one 1st). Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

items.name: Chaos Channeler
entries: When you use your {@spell Divine Smite|XPHB}, you can expend a use of your Channel Divinity to wield the chaos of wild magic. For the next minute, whenever you use your {@spell Divine Smite|XPHB} (including the triggering use), or a {@footnote {@filter Smite spell|spells|search=Smite}|Smite spells are Paladin spells with Smite in their name.}*, choose one: Darkness or Light. Roll an additional {@dice 1d8}, add the result to the damage of the smite, and gain the corresponding effect on the Wild Magic Table. You can roll on the table a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier, regaining all expended uses upon finishing a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.caption: Wild Magic of Darkness
rows: You gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to twice your Charisma modifier.
The target is {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} until the end of its next turn.
You can immediately teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.
Up to two creatures that can see you within 30 feet are {@condition Frightened|XPHB} of you until the end of their next turn.
You can use your {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to make a single melee weapon attack.
You gain a bonus to your AC equal to your Charisma modifier until the start of your next turn, as you become wreathed in shadow.
You take 7 points of Necrotic damage.

Roll one additional {@dice d8}, and gain the corresponding effect from the Light table. If this effect was triggered by rolling on the Light table, the triggering attack becomes a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB}, instead.

entries.caption: Wild Magic of Light
rows: You regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to half the damage dealt by the smite.
You regain one expended 1st level spell slot.
You resist the next instance of damage you take within the next minute.
You restore a number of points to your Lay on Hands pool equal to 5 times your Paladin Level.
You can immediately take the {@action Dash|XPHB}, {@action Disengage|XPHB}, or {@action Dodge|XPHB} action.
The target is {@condition Blinded|XPHB} until the start of its next turn.
You take 7 points of Radiant damage.

Roll one additional {@dice d8}, and gain the corresponding effect from the Darkness table. If this effect was triggered by first rolling on the Darkness table, the triggering attack becomes a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB}, instead.

subclassFeature.name: Aura of Chaos
entries: You exude an aura of chaotic, magical energy, influencing the world in unpredictable ways.

When a creature within your aura makes an {@action Attack|XPHB} Roll or {@variantrule Saving Throw|XPHB} at {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to cause them to take the lower of the dice rolled, rather than the higher, for their result.

When an allied creature of your choice within your aura makes a {@variantrule Saving Throw|XPHB} at {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}, it can use a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to take the higher of the dice rolled, rather than the lower, for their result.
At 18th level, the range of this aura increases to 30 feet.

subclassFeature.name: Yin From Yang
entries: You can chaotically influence the divine magic of your Lay on Hands feature to invert its curative powers.

As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can touch a creature within reach and expend any amount of points from your Lay on Hands pool. The target must make a Constitution saving throw, taking Necrotic damage equal to the number of points you expend on a failed save, or half as much on a success. Constructs are immune to the damage dealt this way.

subclassFeature.name: Wild Magic Alignment
entries: At the start of your turn, you can enter a state of total connection to wild magic, letting you exert some degree of control over your surges for the next minute. Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

items: When you use your Chaos Channeler ability, you do not choose Darkness or Light. Instead, you roll {@dice 2d8}, and choose one result on each d8 to gain a corresponding effect from each table.
Creatures of your choice in your aura have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws to avoid or end the effects of spells.

subclassFeature.name: Circle of Mutation
entries: Life is an accident. A flash of chance hurled consciousness into a vacant multiverse, and a battle for survival raged evermore.

Mutation is the force of change, incremental and chaotic shifts in biology and magic that shape life over millenia. Druids of the Circle of Mutation exacerbate that process, drawing on the magic to enhance themselves and their allies with formidable adaptations that nature would take aeons to produce.

Druids of this circle embrace change, and look to the mightiest monsters of the multiverse for inspiration in cultivating their form. They understand the body to be a canvass, one that can be stripped bare, twisted, crumpled, and reimagined endlessly in the pursuit of temporary abilities. They embrace and celebrate change wherever they find it, viewing the natural world not as something that is immutable or "finished", but as an eternal process in constant flux that should be cultivated, rather than preserved.

subclassFeature.name: Circle Spells
entries: When you reach a Druid level specified in the Circle of Mutation Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

subclassFeature.name: Invoke Mutation
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can expend a use of Wild Shape to adopt a fleeting mutation from the Mutation table. You gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to your Wisdom modifier + your Druid level, alongside the benefits of your chosen mutation. Your mutation lasts for 10 minutes, or until you use this feature again, or until you choose to end it (no action required).

entries.caption: Mutation Table
rows: You have Devil's Sight out to 30 feet. You can also cast {@spell Dispel Magic|XPHB} as part of the {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} you use to adopt this mutation, and as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on subsequent turns.

The reach of your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes} increases by 10 feet, and you deal {@damage 1d10} Slashing damage when you hit with them. You can also use your Wisdom modifier for the attack and damage rolls of your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes}.

As an action, you can release a burst of elemental energy in a 15-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|cone}. Creatures in that area make a Dexterity saving throw (DC = 8 + your Wisdom modifier + your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}) taking Xd4 Fire damage, where X is equal to your Wisdom modifier, on a failed save, or half as much on a success.

You gain a {@variantrule Swim Speed|XPHB} equal to twice your walking speed, and can breathe underwater. Your AC also increases by an amount equal to half your Wisdom modifier (rounded down) so long as you aren't wearing Heavy Armour.
You are immune to the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} and {@condition Frightened|XPHB} conditions, and you add your Wisdom modifier to Charisma checks and Charisma Saving Throws.

subclassFeature.name: Advanced Mutation
entries: When you adopt a mutation, you gain an additional benefit, depending on your choice, as shown on the Advanced Mutation table.

entries.caption: Advanced Mutation Table
rows: You can cast the spell {@spell Counterspell|XPHB} without a spell slot.

When you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action, you can Attack twice not once. Your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes} count as magical for the purpose of overcoming damage {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB|resistances} and {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB|immunities}. If you score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} or reduce a creature to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} with an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, you can make an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} that turn.
You have a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} equal to your walking speed.

Any Acid, Cold, Fire, Poison, Bludgeoning, Slashing, or Piercing damage you take is reduced by an amount equal to your Wisdom modifier (before calculating {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB|resistances} or {@variantrule Vulnerability|XPHB|vulnerabilities}).

As a part of the {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} you use to adopt this mutation, and as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on subsequent turns, you can let loose a furious roar. Creatures of your choice within 30 feet that can hear you gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to your Wisdom modifier. Other creatures within 30 feet that can hear you must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC = 8 + your Wisdom modifier + your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}) or be {@condition Frightened|XPHB} of you until the start of your next turn.

subclassFeature.name: Viral Mutation
entries: When you adopt a mutation, you can choose a number of willing creatures you can see equal to your Wisdom modifier to share in your transformation. They gain the 3rd-level benefit of your mutation from the Mutation table for as long as your mutation lasts. Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, unless you expend a 3rd level spell slot to regain a use of it (no action required).

subclassFeature.name: Adaptive Mutagen
entries: While mutated, you regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to your Wisdom modifier at the start of each of your turns as long as you are conscious and below half {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.
Additionally, any creature that hits you with a melee attack roll while you are mutated is {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} until the start of its next turn.

subclassFeature.name: Nexus
entries: Healing isn't reserved for those blessed by nature or the divine. Every living thing is a machine of infinite complexity, propelled by innumerable ley lines of simmering energy that can be mapped, studied, enhanced, and sabotaged.

Nexus Rogues are the cartographers of anatomy, scholars who wield their biological insights with incredible precision to influence living things. Most act as respected healers, able to alleviate pain and eradicate disease by altering the flow of energy through the body at the touch of a needle. However, just as one who can craft an antidote must be intimately aware of the poison, a Nexus Rogue is able to sow unimaginable pain and torment as easily as they can undo it. To victims of such warriors, a mere pinprick can be as lethal as a slashed throat.

subclassFeature.name: Needle Master
entries: You are an expert at wielding {@item Filiform Needle|DMSecretWeapon24|Filiform Needles}, as both a tool for aiding others and a deadly weapon in battle. When you hit a creature with an attack using a {@item Filiform Needle|DMSecretWeapon24}, you can use your Sneak Attack the next time you hit that creature with an attack using a {@item Filiform Needle|DMSecretWeapon24} before the end of the turn, even if you don't have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on the attack roll.
In addition, you gain proficiency in the {@skill Medicine|XPHB} skill.

subclassFeature.name: Anatomical Sabotage
entries: When you roll Sneak Attack damage for an attack with a {@item Filiform Needle|DMSecretWeapon24}, you can impart one effect of your choice from the following options for each die that rolls a 1 (you cannot pick the same effect twice, unless otherwise specified).

items.name: Bewilder
entries: Until the end of the target's next turn, it takes a penalty to saving throws to maintain {@status Concentration|XPHB} equal to half the number of Sneak Attack dice rolled (including from the triggering damage).

items.name: Discombobulate
entries: Until the end of the target's next turn, it has a penalty to attack rolls against you equal to half the number of Sneak Attack dice rolled.

items.name: Enrage
entries: Until the end of the target's next turn, it takes a penalty to attack rolls against creatures other than you equal to half the number of Sneak Attack dice rolled.

items.name: Pain
entries: The target takes additional damage equal to half the number of Sneak Attack dice rolled. You can select this effect multiple times.

items.name: Stagger
entries: Until the end of the target's next turn, its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is reduced by a number of feet equal to five times half the number of Sneak Attack dice rolled.

items.name: Unbalance
entries: The next attack roll made against the target before the end of its next turn has a bonus equal to half the number of Sneak Attack dice rolled.

subclassFeature.name: Anatomical Restoration
entries: As an action, you can use a {@item Filiform Needle|DMSecretWeapon24} on a willing creature within your reach, influencing the flow of energy across its body. Choose one of the following effects to impart.

items.name: Arcane Revival
entries: The creature regains one expended spell slot of a level up to half your number of Sneak Attack dice.

items.name: Invigorate
entries: The target's {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level decreases by 1.

items.name: Rejuvenate
entries: Any conditions affecting the creature from among the following end: {@condition Blinded|XPHB}, {@condition Charmed|XPHB}, {@condition Frightened|XPHB}, {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB}, {@condition Poisoned|XPHB}, {@condition Stunned|XPHB}, or reduce the target's {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level by one.

items.name: Revitalize
entries: The creature can expend and roll a number of its {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB} up to your number of Sneak Attack dice. It regains {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the result plus its Constitution modifier. Any {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} regained this way that would exceed its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point maximum} are gained as {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} instead.
Once a creature benefits from this feature, it cannot do so again until it finishes a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Leyline Resurrection
entries: Over the course of 10 minutes, you can use a {@item Filiform Needle|DMSecretWeapon24} on the corpse of a creature that has died within the last hour, steadily coaxing a flow of life energy through the body. At the end of that time, roll your Sneak Attack dice; the creature returns to life with a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the result. You can't return to life a creature that died of old age, nor can you restore any missing body parts. Once a creature has been restored to life with this feature, it can't be resurrected in this way again for {@dice 1d10} days.

subclassFeature.name: Ultimate Precision
entries: Your Anatomical Sabotage feature triggers anytime you roll a 1 or a 2 on a Sneak Attack dice.

Additionally, you can choose to treat a d20 result of 18 or 19 on an attack roll you make with your {@item Filiform Needle|DMSecretWeapon24|filiform needles} as a natural 20. Once you do, you cannot do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Oath of the Dragon Rider
entries: The Oath of the Dragon Rider calls to paladins who forge a connection with a draconic companion to inspire hope and courage on the battlefield. A common choice for holy cavalry, these paladins form deep bonds with warrior mounts, forging a path of glory through the thickets of bloody combat.

To these paladins, a steed is more than a tool of war. They see spiritual value in the preservation, study, and alignment of dragons and nature. Fiercely protective of their companions, paladins who take this oath train ceaselessly in mounted combat, and take pride in treating their companions with the same respect and dignity as any other warrior. More than mere flying transport, a bonded dragon is one's first and last ally, and most powerful weapon.

entries.name: Tenets of the Dragon Rider
entries: A paladin who takes this oath commits to these tenets.

items.name: Strength in Unity
entries: The one who fights alone is the first to fall. Strength is numbers.

items.name: Loyalty unto Death
entries: Once trust is earned, it is kept forever. Better to die standing with honor and allies than to flee alone and live as a coward.

items.name: Friendship
entries: It is the bonds formed between friends and family that will save us at the last. Rarely is lasting peace forged with the sword.

subclassFeature.name: Draconic Divinity
entries: You gain the following Channel Divinity options.

items.name: Dragon Summoner
entries: When you finish casting the {@spell Find Familiar|XPHB} spell, you can expend a use of your Channel Divinity to modify the spell in the following ways to turn the creature into your draconic familiar:

items: The familiar you summon uses the {@filter stat block of a dragon|bestiary|Challenge Rating=[&0;&7]|type=dragon} with a maximum CR equal to one third your paladin level.
Its alignment changes to match yours.

It acts on your turn in the {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} order and can move as normal, but it cannot take actions unless you use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to command it to take the {@action Dash|XPHB} or {@action Disengage|XPHB} actions, or to command it to make a single melee attack. You can use your action to command it to take any action listed in its stat block.
If its size is Medium or larger, it becomes Small. Once you reach Paladin level 7, you can choose to ignore this modification when you finish casting the spell.

items.name: Lead the Charge!
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can expend a use of your Channel Divinity to empower a determined, headlong assault on the enemy. You, or your mount if it isn't {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB}, can move up to 30 feet, and then you can immediately make one melee weapon attack against a target within reach.

subclassFeature.name: Oath Spells
entries: You gain oath spells at the paladin levels listed in the Oath of the Dragon Rider Spells table.

entries.caption: Oath of the Dragon Rider Spells

entries.name: Player Tips! Summoning Dragons
entries: The Oath of the Dragon Rider lets your familiar use the stat block of a dragon. There are many dragon stat blocks with varying CRs that you can choose from as you gain paladin levels—here are some recommended stat blocks you can use from the free System Reference Document or introduced in this expansion.

rows: {@creature Brass Dragon Wyrmling|XMM} or {@creature Copper Dragon Wyrmling|XMM}

{@creature Black Dragon Wyrmling|XMM|Black}, {@creature Bronze Dragon Wyrmling|XMM|Bronze}, {@creature Green Dragon Wyrmling|XMM|Green}, {@creature Silver Dragon Wyrmling|XMM|Silver}, or {@creature White Dragon Wyrmling|XMM}
{@creature Blue Dragon Wyrmling|XMM|Blue} or {@creature Gold Dragon Wyrmling|XMM}
{@creature Red Dragon Wyrmling|XMM}, {@creature Young Transparent Dragon|DMSecretWeapon24}
{@creature Young Brass Dragon|XMM}, {@creature Young White Dragon|XMM}, {@creature Wyvern|XMM}

subclassFeature.name: Summoner's Aura
entries: You emanate an aura of command while you are not {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB}. The aura extends 10 feet from you in every direction, but not through {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|total cover}.

Creatures in your aura that you have summoned or awakened (via a spell such as {@spell Awaken|XPHB}, {@spell Find Familiar|XPHB}, or {@spell Find Steed|XPHB}) have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws, can use your spell save DC when they force another creature to make a saving throw, and count as one size larger when determining its carrying capacity and the weight it can push, drag, or lift.
At 18th level, the range of this aura increases to 30 feet.

subclassFeature.name: Unconquerable Bond
entries: While you are concentrating on a spell that includes your draconic familiar as a target, such as {@spell Bless|XPHB} or {@spell Haste|XPHB}, you gain a bonus to Constitution saving throws made to maintain {@status Concentration|XPHB} equal to its CR and you share its damage {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB|immunities}.

Additionally, when your draconic familiar would take damage, you can choose to end {@status Concentration|XPHB} on a spell that includes it as a target (no action required), and it takes no damage instead. Once you prevent damage in this way, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also regain this ability by expending a spell slot of 4th level or higher (no action required).

subclassFeature.name: Master of the Mount
entries: Your mastery of combat and bond with your steed imbues you with divine power while mounted. At the start of your turn while mounted, you can gain the following benefits for 1 minute (no action required):

items.name: Divine Fortification
entries: Your mount has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to all damage types.

items.name: Endless Onslaught
entries: Your mount automatically recharges any of its Recharge actions at the start of its turn.

items.name: Ferocious
entries: Creatures of your choice in your Summoner's Aura area have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on saving throws forced by your mount.

items.name: Perfect Form
entries: Your mount cannot fall {@condition Prone|XPHB} while both you and it are not {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB}.
Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, unless you expend a 5th-level spell slot to regain your use of it (no action required).

subclassFeature.name: Voidkeeper
entries: Guardians against the unknowable, Voidkeepers stand resolute in the face of the blind infinity that stretches between worlds. Warriors of this conclave wage a ceaseless, silent war against unimaginable, aberrant horrors that claw at the boundaries of reality—nameless, undulating monsters eager to burst through the veil that divides planes of existence and devour the fabric of worlds.

You wield powers to shape reality, shift between dimensions, and tether creatures to the material world. To be such a Ranger is to face the bizarre, reckon with the unimaginable, and battle horrors that would drive weaker minds to madness.

subclassFeature.name: Reality Tether
entries: When you target a creature within 30 feet of you with a level 1+ Ranger spell, you can anchor the target to you. For 1 minute or until you choose to end the connection (no action required), the target cannot teleport or move between dimensions unless you allow it to do so, it cannot willingly move more than 30 feet away from you while you are within 30 feet of it, and immediately after it makes an attack against a creature other than you, it takes {@damage 1d8} Psychic damage. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} unless you expend a spell slot to restore your use of it (no action required).

subclassFeature.name: Voidhardened
entries: You have a bonus on saving throws made to avoid or end the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} and {@condition Frightened|XPHB} conditions equal to half your Ranger level.

Additionally, you automatically succeed on Intelligence saving throws made to resist effects that deal Psychic damage, such as the {@spell Befuddlement|XPHB} and {@spell Contact Other Plane|XPHB} spells and a {@creature Mind Flayer|XMM}'s Mind Blast action. If such an effect would deal half damage on a successful save, you take no damage on a success instead.

subclassFeature.name: Voidkeeper Spells
entries: When you reach a Ranger level specified in the Voidkeeper Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

subclassFeature.name: Voidsight
entries: You have {@sense Truesight|XPHB} with a range of 10 feet, which increases to 30 feet when you reach Ranger level 15.

In addition, whenever you cast a Ranger spell targeting a creature you can see within range of your {@sense Truesight|XPHB}, you can peer beyond the material reality of that being and into its psychic essence. Until the end of your next turn or until you use this feature again, you know the target's damage {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB|Resistances}, {@variantrule Vulnerability|XPHB|Vulnerabilities}, and {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB|Immunities}, and it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against you.

subclassFeature.name: Void Step
entries: On your turn, you can expend movement to teleport a number of feet equal to the movement you expend. If you teleport 30 feet or more in this way in a single instance, the next time you hit a creature with a weapon or {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} this turn, the target takes an additional {@damage 2d6} Force damage.

subclassFeature.name: Plunge In Nothingness
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can force one creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself to make a Charisma saving throw against your spell save DC. A creature anchored to you with your Reality Tether feature has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on its save. On a failed save, you wrench yourself and the target into the void between planes of existence. In the void, creatures without {@sense Truesight|XPHB} are {@condition Blinded|XPHB}. Creatures with {@sense Truesight|XPHB} can both see and hear the plane you originated from, which is cast in shades of translucent gray, and can see the void itself and creatures within it. Creatures in the void can only affect and be affected by other creatures in the void. Creatures that aren't there can't perceive you or interact with you.

You remain in the void for 1 minute or until you choose to return yourself and the creature to the plane you left (no action required). When you return, you and the target appear in unoccupied spaces as close as possible to the spaces you left.
You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Future Self
entries: Across the infinite multiverse, power can be found in the most unlikely of places. While some barter strength from gods and demons, yours comes from a source even more incredible: yourself, across time. Your patron is you from the future; a future of hope, warmth, and light that shines back to the present and illuminates your path forwards. The magic of you in a place beyond the now echoes backwards across decades, bringing hazy visions of events yet to come, fragments of power you will one day possess, and faith in a future worth fighting for.
{@i This subclass was created by DnD Shorts for CALM, a suicide prevention charity. If you or a loved one needs support, consider reaching out at {@link https://www.thecalmzone.net/}}

subclassFeature.name: The Hope
entries: The connection forged through time with your future self fortifies you with an unshakable faith in the future yet to come. When you roll a 1 on the d20 of a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB}, you gain {@variantrule Heroic Inspiration|XPHB}.
In addition, you gain {@variantrule Heroic Inspiration|XPHB} whenever you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Future Self Spells
entries: The power of your future self echoes across time, vitalising your present self with magic. When you reach a Warlock level specified in the Future Self Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

entries.caption: Future Self Spells
rows: {@spell Bless|XPHB}, {@spell Calm Emotions|XPHB}, {@spell Protection from Evil and Good|XPHB}, {@spell Spiritual Weapon|XPHB}
{@spell Death Ward|XPHB}, {@spell Otiluke's Resilient Sphere|XPHB|Resilient Sphere}

subclassFeature.name: Guiding Memory
entries: When you cast a spell that requires {@status Concentration|XPHB} from the Divination school of magic or your Future Self Spells feature, you can choose to focus your arcane energies on deepening the connection between the present and future. Doing so gives you a hazy glimpse into the memory of your future self, aiding you in avoiding harm. While concentrating on that spell, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity saving throws, and attack rolls made against you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}.
You can use this feature twice, regaining all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Not Today
entries: In moments of catastrophe, you are fortified with the vitality of your future self, which blazes like a beacon. You have a bonus to saving throws made to avoid or end the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition equal to your Warlock Level.

In addition, when you succeed on a saving throw, each creature of your choice within 30 feet of you who failed the saving throw against that same effect can reroll its save, with a bonus equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum bonus of +1), potentially turning a failure into a success.

subclassFeature.name: Future Visions
entries: You receive a bolt of memory from your future self, granting you a split-second insight into events about to unfold. When a creature you can see within 30 feet of you succeeds on an attack roll or ability check, or fails a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB}, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to cause it to reroll the d20. The creature must use the new result.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You also regain your use of it whenever you cast a Divination spell using a spell slot.

subclassFeature.name: All of Me
entries: At the start of your turn, you can channel your arcane power into a shining instant of temporal unity. Echoes of yourself across your lifespan—from a child, to your current self, and into the future—converge into a single moment. You are more than the present you.

This turn, you can take an additional action. In addition, you can maximize one damage roll you make this turn; instead of rolling dice to determine the damage of an attack, spell, or other effect, you can use the highest number possible for each die.
Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Warrior of the Animate Soul
entries: The world of Avestros spins under the gaze of three moons. The Second Moon, Eilere, shines brighter than the sun at dawn, and radiates the energy of purpose. Passion, ambition, desire, and the power to imagine a better world were gifted to all life on Avestros by Eilere, and Monks who train at first light, bathed in Eilere's radiance, can earn the ability to actualise that gift.

Through study and devotion, Eilere grants heroes the power to manifest their own heroic spirit, summoning a spiritual reflection of the soul within. Warriors of the Animate Soul live, train, and fight alongside their life force made physical—a Spirit Beast that embodies their passion and character. These Spirit Beasts are part of the Monks who summon them, actualised in the tangible world with an independent mind and voice. Typical Spirit Beast shapes include domestic mammals like dogs and mice, but many forms have been observed, from fish, to hummingbirds, to dinosaurs. In all cases, the shape and character of the Spirit Beast is a reflection of a warrior's soul, with the pair living in effortless harmony in daily life, and striking in perfect unity when called to battle.

subclassFeature.name: Animate Soul
entries: Through the magic of Eilere, the Second Moon, you have the power to manifest your own soul as a {@creature Spirit Beast|DMSecretWeapon24}, which you can communicate with telepathically as long as you are both on the same plane of existence. Its statistics appear in the {@creature Spirit Beast|DMSecretWeapon24} stat block, with abilities that vary depending on your alignment. You determine its appearance, which can be that of any Beast that is Tiny or Small; your choices don't affect the Spirit Beast's game statistics other than its size.
The Spirit Beast is {@variantrule Friendly [Attitude]|XPHB|Friendly} to you and your allies and obeys you. It vanishes if you die.

items.name: The Spirit Beast in Combat
entries: In combat, the {@creature Spirit Beast|DMSecretWeapon24} acts during your turn. It can move on its own, but the only action it takes is the {@action Help|XPHB} action, unless you use your action to telepathically command it to take another action.

items.name: Spirit Synchronicity
entries: When you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action, you can forgo one of your attacks to allow your Spirit Beast to use its action to make one attack of its own. Additionally, when you take the {@action Dash|XPHB}, {@action Disengage|XPHB}, or {@action Dodge|XPHB} action, the Spirit Beast can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to do that same action.

items.name: Restoring the Spirit Beast
entries: When the Spirit Beast falls to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, it vanishes. You can resummon it by using an action and expending one of your unexpended {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB}, at which point it returns to the physical world in an unoccupied space you can see within 10 feet of you with all its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. Additionally, as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} while the Spirit Beast is within 120 feet of you, you can expend up to two unexpended {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB}, roll them, and cause the Spirit Beast to regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the result plus your Wisdom modifier.

subclassFeature.name: Eilere's Courage
entries: If you have no Focus Points remaining, you can give yourself {@variantrule Heroic Inspiration|XPHB} whenever you start your turn without it.

subclassFeature.name: Soulbound Warriors
entries: In battle, you and your Spirit Beast act in spectacular harmony.

items.name: Soul Shimmer
entries: While both you and your Spirit Beast are within 5 feet of a creature, that creature has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against you and your Spirit Beast.

items.name: Soul Fortification
entries: Your Spirit Beast has {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to the damage type determined by its Spirit Bond trait.

subclassFeature.name: Eilere's Magnification
entries: When you manifest your Spirit Beast or you restore its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|hit points} with your Restoring the Spirit Beast feature, you can choose for it to become any size from Tiny to Large, if there is room.

Additionally, it cannot lose {@status Concentration|XPHB} on spells as a result of taking damage and the damage of its Rend attack increases to include two rolls of your Martial Arts die instead of one.

subclassFeature.name: Soul Burst
entries: You can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action and expend 7 Focus Points to channel the force of your soul through your companion, unleashing a wave of soul-infused energy from your Spirit Beast in a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from it. Each creature of your choice in the area makes a Charisma saving throw (DC equals 8 plus your Wisdom modifier and {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}). On a failure, the creature takes damage equal to seven rolls of your Martial Arts die and suffers a condition until the end of its next turn. On a success, the creature takes half as much damage only. The damage and condition are the same as those in your Spirit Beast's Spirit Bond and Spirit Strike traits. Other creatures in the area gain {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to the damage types that your Spirit Beast resists for the next minute.

subclassFeature.name: Deadwalker Domain
entries: When souls are claimed by death, deadwalkers call them back home. Clerics of this domain are marshalls of the Undead; in days of old, they ushered fresh corpses to a safe resting place, ensuring that no spirits grew vengeful when lost to frigid mountains or forgotten pathways, or fell prey to soul-devouring demons. Undead under the command of a deadwalker are easy to spot—bound by rigor mortis and divine impetus, they move with stiff limbs in a characteristic "hopping" motion, to the mournful knell of a deadwalker's commanding bell.

Despite their grizzly mission, deadwalkers are respected and necessary guardians of lost souls. They protect and honour the dead, weaving terrifying, necromantic curses over any mortal foolish enough to desecrate sacred places and slumbering spirits.

subclassFeature.name: Curse of Undeath
entries: When a non-Undead creature within 30 feet of you takes Necrotic damage, you can expend one use of your Channel Divinity to place a curse of undeath upon it (no action required). The target is cursed for 1 hour. While cursed, the target's creature type is Undead and it can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Deadwalker Domain Spells
entries: Your connection to this divine domain ensures you always have certain spells ready. When you reach a Cleric level specified in the Deadwalker Domain Spells table, you thereafter always have the listed spells prepared.

entries.caption: Deadwalker Domain Spells
rows: {@spell Charm Person|XPHB}, {@spell Command|XPHB}, {@spell Rigor Mortis|DMSecretWeapon24}, {@spell Toll the Dead|XPHB}, {@spell Zombify|DMSecretWeapon24}

subclassFeature.name: Master of Undeath
entries: Spells you cast that only target Humanoids, such as {@spell Hold Person|XPHB}, can also target Undead.

In addition, when you cast a spell that has a casting time of an action, you can modify it so that it has a casting time of a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, so long as it targets at least one Undead. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

subclassFeature.name: Necrotic Guile
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you present your {@item Holy Symbol|XPHB} and beckon Undead. Each Undead of your choice within 30 feet of you makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, an Undead is {@condition Charmed|XPHB} by you for 1 minute or until you or your allies damage it.

subclassFeature.name: Undead Commander
entries: Any Undead {@condition Charmed|XPHB} by you automatically fails its saving throw against spells you cast from your Deadwalker Domain Spells feature.

subclassFeature.name: True Necromancer
entries: You can cast {@spell Command|XPHB} without expending a spell slot at a level equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum level 1), so long as it only targets Undead. When you cast {@spell Command|XPHB} with this feature, you gain a new command option: Attack.

items.name: Attack
entries: The target moves up to its speed in a direction you choose, makes one attack against a target of your choice, and then ends its turn.

sizeEntry.name: Size:
entries: Omenix are well known for their towering stature, long legs, and lengthy, flexible necks. Most grown omenix stand comfortably over 7 feet tall. Your size is Medium.

entries.name: Avian Gifts
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Perception|XPHB} and {@skill Performance|XPHB} skills.

entries.name: Elegant Motion
entries: You can add half your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} (rounded down) to Dexterity saving throws.

entries.name: Embered Wings
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can flap your wings, giving life to a haze of dancing sparks. The embers shed {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} in a 15-foot radius until the end of your next turn, or you can direct them to light a candle, torch, or a small campfire. Allied creatures within the fleeting ember's radius can add {@dice 1d4} to their Charisma ({@skill Performance|XPHB}) checks.

entries.name: Fierce Beak
entries: Your beak is a weapon that you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes}. It has a reach of 10 feet, and when you hit with it, the strike deals {@damage 1d6} + your Strength modifier Piercing damage, instead of the Bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

entries.name: Limited Flight
entries: You have wings, but your size and weight make it difficult to remain airborne for long. When you take the {@action Dash|XPHB} action, you gain a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} until the end of that turn. If you are still airborne at the end of the turn and unsupported, you fall.

entries.name: Single Leg Stance
entries: Omenix are adept at standing on only one leg, allowing them to put their other foot to good use. Your free foot can manipulate simple objects, pick up or set down Tiny objects, or wield a weapon that has the {@itemProperty L|XPHB|Light} property. Though dextrous, your feet lack the nimbleness to perform the Somatic components of spells.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Common and one other language that you and your GM agree is appropriate for the character.

sizeEntry.name: Size:
entries: Mob-mob's large bells and long limbs cut an impressive figure, especially in water. At full length, they can reach up to 9 feet long. Your size is Medium.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries: You can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Barbed Limbs
entries: Your arms are adorned with barbs that contain a potent venom. When you hit with an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, you can have the strike deal {@damage 1d6} + your Constitution modifier Poison damage, instead of the Bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike. Additionally, when you score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} against a creature with an unarmed strike, that creature is {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} and its movement {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} falls to 0 until the end of its next turn.

entries.name: Bioluminescence
entries: The bell that crowns your head is capable of emitting light and shifting hue. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can choose to emanate {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} in a radius of up to 30 feet. The light can be any colour, or mixture of colours, that you choose, and you continue glowing until you choose to end the effect as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

entries.name: Long Limbs
entries: When you make a melee attack on your turn, your reach for it is 5 feet greater than normal.

entries.name: Squashable
entries: Despite your impressive height, your body is flexible and compressible. You can squeeze through spaces as narrow as 5 inches wide, provided you aren't wearing or carrying anything, and you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws made to avoid or end the {@condition Grappled|XPHB} condition.

entries.name: Vortex Sea Survivor
entries: You have proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: {@skill Athletics|XPHB}, {@skill Medicine|XPHB}, {@skill Nature|XPHB}, or {@skill Survival|XPHB}.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Common and one other language that you and your GM agree is appropriate for the character.

sizeEntry.name: Size:
entries: Avestrosian goblins are small, even relative to other goblinoid species. Your size is Small.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You can see in {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} within 60 feet of you as if it were {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB}, and in {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB} as if it were {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB}. You discern colors in that {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB} only as shades of gray.

entries.name: Brazen
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws to avoid or end the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition.

entries.name: Curious Mind
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Investigation|XPHB} skill.

entries.name: Nimble Warrior
entries: You can make a single weapon attack as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, regaining all expended uses upon finishing a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Wily Engineer
entries: You have proficiency in two types of {@item Artisan's Tools|XPHB} of your choice, and the amount of time it takes for you to craft non-magical objects is halved.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Common and one other language that you and your GM agree is appropriate for the character.

sizeEntry.name: Size:
entries: Molimpodsea are short and lithe, with the tallest individuals reaching only 4 feet tall. Your size is Small.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: Lives spent hunting deep beneath the ocean have granted molimpodsea superior vision in darkness. You can see in {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} within 60 feet of you as if it were {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB}, and in {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB} as if it were {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB}. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Piercing Tail
entries: Your tail is a natural weapon, which you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes}. On a hit, it deals {@damage 1d6} + your Strength modifier Piercing damage, rather than the Bludgeoning damage normal for an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}.

entries.name: Superior Seafarer
entries: You can breathe air and water, and you have a +1 bonus to your AC while submerged in water.

entries.name: Tail Stinger
entries: When you hit a creature with an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} using your tail, you can choose to deal an additional {@damage 1d12} Poison damage. The Poison damage increases to {@damage 2d12} at 5th level, {@damage 3d12} at 11th level, and {@damage 4d12} at 17th level. Your body produces this poison naturally, but your reserves are not infinite; you can only deal Poison damage in this way a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, regaining all expended uses upon finishing a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Vortex Sea Plunderer
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Intimidation|XPHB} and {@skill Survival|XPHB} skills.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You can speak, read, and write Common and one other language that you and your GM agree is appropriate for the character.

sizeEntry.name: Size:
entries: Avestrosian Elves stand shoulder-to-shoulder with the tallest humans. Your size is Medium.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You can see in {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} within 60 feet of you as if it were {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB}, and in {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB} as if it were {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB}. You can't discern color in darkness, only shades of gray.

entries.name: Motivated
entries: When you take damage, you can choose to gain a point of {@variantrule Heroic Inspiration|XPHB} if you don't have one already. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, regaining all expended uses upon finishing a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Obstinate Soul
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws to resist or end the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition.

entries.name: Sleepwalker
entries: As long as you have at least 1 Hit Point, while you are {@condition Unconscious|XPHB}: you are not {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB}, you do not drop what you are holding or fall {@condition Prone|XPHB}, you do not automatically fail Strength or Dexterity saving throws, and creatures within 5 feet who hit you with an attack roll do not automatically score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB}.

Instead, while you are {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} and have at least 1 Hit Point: you are {@condition Blinded|XPHB}, you can only speak in a quiet mumble, and you cannot perform the Verbal component of spells. Otherwise, you can move and take actions as normal.

entries.name: Lineage
entries: Your Elven Lineage confers additional benefits; choose one of the following options.

items: {@b Sea Elf.} You have proficiency in {@skill Survival|XPHB}, you have a {@variantrule Swim Speed|XPHB} equal to your walking speed, and you can hold your breath for up to 8 hours. Additionally, while submerged in water, you can take the {@action Dash|XPHB} action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

{@b Jungle Elf.} You have proficiency in the {@skill Nature|XPHB} skill, your base walking speed increases to 35 feet, and you have a {@variantrule Climb Speed|XPHB} equal to your walking speed. Additionally, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on checks made to influence or interact peacefully with Beasts and Plants.

{@b Winged Elf.} You have proficiency in the {@skill Acrobatics|XPHB} skill. When you fall more than 10 feet and you aren't {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB}, you can use a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to extend your vestigial wings; you take no fall damage from that fall and glide 1 foot horizontally for every 1 foot you fall. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can perform a vertical leap, jumping a number of feet directly upwards equal to 5 x your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, regaining all expended uses upon finishing a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

items.name: Lineage (Sea Elf)
entries: You have proficiency in {@skill Survival|XPHB}, you have a {@variantrule Swim Speed|XPHB} equal to your walking speed, and you can hold your breath for up to 8 hours. Additionally, while submerged in water, you can take the {@action Dash|XPHB} action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

items.name: Lineage (Jungle Elf)
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Nature|XPHB} skill, your base walking speed increases to 35 feet, and you have a {@variantrule Climb Speed|XPHB} equal to your walking speed. Additionally, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on checks made to influence or interact peacefully with Beasts and Plants.

items.name: Lineage (Winged Elf)
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Acrobatics|XPHB} skill. When you fall more than 10 feet and you aren't {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB}, you can use a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to extend your vestigial wings; you take no fall damage from that fall and glide 1 foot horizontally for every 1 foot you fall. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can perform a vertical leap, jumping a number of feet directly upwards equal to 5 x your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, regaining all expended uses upon finishing a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

sizeEntry.name: Size:
entries: Powgarfoot are naturally hulking, beefy folk, reaching up to 8 feet tall. Your size is Medium.

entries.name: Clawed Paws
entries: You have claws that you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes}. When you hit with them, the strike deals {@damage 1d6} + your Strength modifier Slashing damage, instead of the Bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

entries.name: Delightful Appetite
entries: When you spend at least 1 minute eating, you can expend a number of {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Dice} up to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Modifier}, roll them, add your Constitution modifier to the result (minimum +1), and regain that many {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. Any hit points you regain in this way that would exceed your Hit Point maximum grant you {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} instead, which last for 10 minutes. Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Strong Stomach
entries: You are immune to the negative effects of poisons, toxins and other harmful substances that you ingest.

entries.name: Resolute Mind
entries: You can add your Constitution modifier to saving throws made to avoid or end the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} and {@condition Frightened|XPHB} conditions.

entries.name: Skilled Paws
entries: You have proficiency with {@item Cook's Utensils|XPHB} and in one skill of your choice from among {@skill Acrobatics|XPHB}, {@skill Animal Handling|XPHB}, {@skill Athletics|XPHB}, {@skill Insight|XPHB}, {@skill Nature|XPHB}, or {@skill Survival|XPHB}.

entries.name: Powerful Build
entries: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You speak Common and one other language you feel is appropriate for your character.

sizeEntry.name: Size:
entries: Heartlings are made from magical material of their creator's choice and in their creator's vision. Many are formed of magical imbued straw, clay, or even flesh. You can determine your appearance, though it has no bearing on your statistics. Your size is Small or Medium.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You can see in {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} within 60 feet of you as if it were {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} and in {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB} as if it were {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB}. You discern colors in that {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB} as shades of gray.

entries.name: Exploit Fear
entries: Creatures {@condition Frightened|XPHB} of you take an additional {@damage 1d6} Psychic damage when you hit them with an attack, and you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on the first attack roll you make each turn against a {@condition Frightened|XPHB} creature.

entries.name: Imbued Talent
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Animal Handling|XPHB} and {@skill Intimidation|XPHB} skills.

entries.name: Magical Construct
entries: As a magical construct, you have the following benefits:

items: You don't require food, water, or sleep to survive
When you take a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you can remain conscious, but you must remain in an inactive, motionless state.

Your magical nature allows you to receive benefits from healing magic that typically doesn't affect Constructs, such as from the spells {@spell Cure Wounds|XPHB} and {@spell Spare the Dying|XPHB}, etc.

entries.name: Terrify
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} Action, you can attempt to terrify a number of creatures up to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} within 30 feet of you. The targets must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC = 8 + your Charisma modifier + your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}) or be {@condition Frightened|XPHB} of you for 1 minute. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, regaining 1 expended use upon finishing a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}, and all uses upon finishing a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You speak Common and one other language of your choice.

sizeEntry.name: Size:
entries: Dwarves of Avestros are a little less stocky than those native to other worlds, and can grow up to 5 feet tall. Your size is Medium or Small.

entries.name: Avestrosian Physiology
entries: Due to the unique, magical biology of dwarves native to Avestros, your body is magically supported by mists and vapour. You can walk and climb on cloud, mist, steam, fog, and other heavy gaseous phenomena as though they were {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}.

entries.name: Ether Touched
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saves to avoid or end the {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} and {@condition Stunned|XPHB} conditions.

entries.name: Dwarven Flight
entries: Starting at 3rd level, your innate dwarven magic allows you to support yourself in the skies. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} while you aren't wearing medium or heavy armour, you can grant yourself a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} equal to your walking speed for 10 minutes. Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Skycunning
entries: You have proficiency in one skill of your choice from among {@skill Arcana|XPHB}, {@skill History|XPHB}, {@skill Performance|XPHB}, {@skill Persuasion|XPHB}, or {@skill Survival|XPHB}.

entries.name: Lineage
entries: You are part of a lineage that grants you supernatural abilities. Choose a lineage from the options below and gain its benefits:

items: {@b Skyhopper.} You know the spell {@spell Feather Fall|XPHB} and can cast it without a spell slot or components a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, regaining any expended uses upon finishing a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast it with any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. From 3rd level, you can use your Dwarven Flight feature regardless of the armour you are wearing. Additionally, if you are mounted on a willing creature, that creature shares any {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} granted by your Dwarven Flight.

{@b Terrestrial.} You know the spell {@spell Fog Cloud|XPHB} and can cast it without a spell slot or components a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, regaining any expended uses upon finishing a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast it with any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. From 3rd level, cloud, mist, steam, fog, and other gaseous phenomena don't obstruct your vision.

items.name: Lineage (Skyhopper)
entries: You know the spell {@spell Feather Fall|XPHB} and can cast it without a spell slot or components a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, regaining any expended uses upon finishing a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast it with any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.

From 3rd level, you can use your Dwarven Flight feature regardless of the armour you are wearing. Additionally, if you are mounted on a willing creature, that creature shares any {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} granted by your Dwarven Flight.

items.name: Lineage (Terrestrial)
entries: You know the spell {@spell Fog Cloud|XPHB} and can cast it without a spell slot or components a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, regaining any expended uses upon finishing a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast it with any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.
From 3rd level, cloud, mist, steam, fog, and other gaseous phenomena don't obstruct your vision.

sizeEntry.name: Size:
entries: A mimikin's true form is similar in size and shape to a human. While in your true form, you are Medium or Small.

entries.name: Adhesive
entries: Your skin is waxy, and has the power to adhere to anything that touches it. When a creature no more than two size categories larger than you touches you or is touched by you, you can use a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to return to your true form (if you are not already in it), and force the target to make a Strength saving throw (DC = 8 + your Constitution modifier + your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}). On a failed save, the creature is {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by you. It can use an action on its turns to attempt a Strength or Dexterity saving throw to escape the grapple.

The adhesive quality of your skin wears down over uses, and replenishes as you rest. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, regaining one expended use upon finishing a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}, and all expended uses upon finishing a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Blistering Touch
entries: A creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by you takes {@damage 1d8} + your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} Acid damage at the start of each of your turns.

entries.name: Frightening Forms
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Deception|XPHB} and {@skill Intimidation|XPHB} skills.

entries.name: Shapechanger
entries: You can use an action to change your shape and appearance, polymorphing into the form of another humanoid creature or an inanimate object that is Small or Medium sized, or reverting to your true form. If you are adopting the form of a specific creature or object, you must have seen it. Any equipment you are wearing or carrying is worn by your new form if able, or absorbed into your body if not. While you are transformed, you are visually indistinguishable from the species or object you are impersonating, though you do not gain any special traits or abilities native to that form. For example, shapeshifting into a winged species would not grant you the ability to fly. If you assume the form of an inanimate object, you can still move and talk, but a creature that sees you doing so can identify you as a mimikin. A creature that touches you can identify you as a mimikin instantly, as your texture is waxy to the touch.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You speak Common and one other language of your choice.

sizeEntry.name: Size:
entries: Epta tend to be impressively large relative to most Humanoids, but regions with more weathered landscapes birth smaller individuals. Epta can be anywhere from 2-8 feet tall. Your size is Medium or Small.

entries.name: Geometric Insight
entries: You have a startling intuition when it comes to mathematical and scientific observation and study. You are proficient with {@item Navigator's Tools|XPHB}, and have proficiency in two of the following skills of your choice: {@skill Arcana|XPHB}, {@skill History|XPHB}, {@skill Investigation|XPHB}, {@skill Medicine|XPHB}, {@skill Nature|XPHB}, {@skill Perception|XPHB}, {@skill Survival|XPHB}.

entries.name: Leyline Conduit
entries: The magic that flows like magma through the deep earth at our feet is what gives you life, and remains a source of your power. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} while touching the earth, dirt, stone, or living wood, you gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to your Level. You can use this feature once, regaining a use any time you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Leyline Mastermind
entries: While you have {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}, you can use your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma modifier (whichever is highest) for all Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

entries.name: Magical Construct
entries: As a magical Construct, you have the following benefits:

items: You don't require food, water, or sleep to survive
When you take a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you can remain conscious, but you must remain in an inactive, motionless state.

Your magical nature allows you to receive benefits from healing magic that typically doesn't affect Constructs, such as from the spells {@spell Cure Wounds|XPHB} and {@spell Spare the Dying|XPHB}, etc.

entries.name: Immutable Form
entries: You automatically succeed on saving throws to avoid effects that would alter your form, such as the {@spell Polymorph|XPHB} spell, unless you allow them to affect you.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You speak Common and one other language of your choice.

race.name: Einherjar

sizeEntry.name: Size:
entries: Einherjar hold the size of the corpse their spirit inhabits. Your size is Medium or Small.

At the Game Master's discretion, you can play an einherjar if your character dies in combat. If you do, replace your species statistics with the following traits when you are resurrected. Alternatively, you can select this species at character creation, in which case you have the following traits:

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You have {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} out to 60 feet.

entries.name: Einherjar Training
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Intimidation|XPHB} and {@skill Religion|XPHB} skills.

entries.name: Magical Undead
entries: As an Undead spirit, you have the following benefits:

items: You don't require food, water, or sleep to survive
Your magical nature allows you to receive benefits from healing magic that typically doesn't affect Undead, such as from the spells {@spell Cure Wounds|XPHB} and {@spell Spare the Dying|XPHB}, etc.

entries.name: Radiant Resilience
entries: As a spirit, granted life beyond death by divine favour, you resist Radiant damage.

entries.name: Surge of Divinity
entries: When you reach character level 3, you can use an action to conjure forth a surge of radiant energy, which engulfs a creature within 30 feet of you. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, regaining all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.
The surge has different effects depending on how adapted the creature is to divine power.

items: If the target resists or is immune to Radiant damage: until the end of your next turn, it gains a 20 foot {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB}, can hover, and can move through objects and creatures as though they were {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}. If these boons end while the target is inside an object or a creature, it is shunted to the nearest unoccupied space, taking {@damage 1d10} Force damage for every 5 feet it is shunted.

Otherwise: roll a number of d6s equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}. The target makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target is engulfed in divine light, taking Radiant damage equal to the result on the d6s, and gains no benefit from being {@condition Invisible|XPHB} until the end of your next turn. On a successful save, it takes half damage only.

entries.name: Warrior Undead
entries: You can use your Constitution instead of Strength when calculating the Strength requirement for Heavy Armour.

entries.name: Optional Trait: Warrior Soul
entries: If your background gives your hero access to an {@filter Origin Feat|feats|category=o}, you can replace your {@filter Origin Feat|feats|category=o} with a {@filter Fighting Style Feat|feats|category=fs} of your choice from the Fighter list.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You speak Common and one other language of your choice.

sizeEntry.name: Size:
entries: Vidjamere are similar in stature to Humans. Your size is Medium or Small.

entries.name: Dream Wanderer
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Insight|XPHB} skill, magic can't put you to sleep against your will, and you are immune to the effects of the {@spell Dream|XPHB} spell.

entries.name: Enter Dream
entries: Over the course of a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, if you are sleeping, you can enter a willing creature's dream who is also taking a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} and is asleep. If you do, you can speak with that creature, regardless of distance and language, and share stories and information. At the end of the {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you gain proficiency in one skill that creature is proficient with, and it gains proficiency with one skill you are proficient with. These proficiencies remain until either one of you begins a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Invoke Dream
entries: As an action, you can stir the hopes and dreams of a willing creature within 30 feet of you. The target gains {@variantrule Heroic Inspiration|XPHB}. You can use this feature a number of times equal to half your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, regaining all expended uses upon finishing a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Invoke Nightmare
entries: As an action, you can stoke the nightmares and insecurities that plague a creature within 30 feet of you. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw (DC = 12 + your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}). On a failed save, roll {@dice 1d6}; the target subtracts the result from their attack rolls and ability checks until the end of your next turn. The die you roll increases to {@dice 1d8} when you reach 5th level, {@dice 1d10} when you reach 11th level, and {@dice 1d12} when you reach 17th level. You can use this feature a number of times equal to half your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, regaining all expended uses upon finishing a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Languages
entries: You speak Common and one other language of your choice.

sizeEntry.name: Size:
entries: Medium (about 4–6 feet tall) or Small (about 3–4 feet tall), chosen when you select this species

entries.name: Anatomy
entries: Two arms and two legs

entries.name: Hakkai's Fortune
entries: When you roll a natural 18 or 19 on a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|d20 test}, you can treat the result as a natural 20. Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Sagacious Rest
entries: When you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}, you can regain a use of a feature or trait that typically only regenerates on a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, such as a Fighter's Action Surge feature, an expended spell slot from the Spellcasting class feature, or your Hakkai's Fortune species trait. If you use this trait to regain an expended spell slot, it cannot be of a level higher than your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}.

entries.name: Guardian's Pledge
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Animal Handling|XPHB} and {@skill Nature|XPHB} skills.

race.name: Geist

sizeEntry.name: Size:
entries: The same as your original species in life
If your character dies, you and your GM can choose for your character to be reborn as a geist. Alternatively, you can choose to begin your adventure as this species.

entries.name: Age
entries: Geists fade from the material world 101 years after materialising.

entries.name: Anatomy
entries: The same as your original species as in life.

entries.name: Gifts of Undeath
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Investigation|XPHB} and {@skill Intimidation|XPHB} skills.

entries.name: Scars of Wadebottom
entries: You {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB|resist} Necrotic damage, and have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saves to avoid or end the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition.

entries.name: Vile Shroud
entries: Starting from 3rd level, you can engulf a creature you can see within 30 feet in an eruption of ectoplasmic energy. If the target resists or is immune to Necrotic damage, it turns {@condition Invisible|XPHB} for 1 minute, or until it makes an attack roll, casts a spell, or forces another creature to make a saving throw. Otherwise, the target takes Xd4 Necrotic damage, where X is your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on the first attack roll or ability check it makes before the start of your next turn. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, regaining all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

sizeEntry.name: Size:
entries: Similar to humans, with the horns and ears of a ram. Your size is Medium or Small (choose when you select this species).

entries.name: Diabolical Gift
entries: Vindivar were created by an evil deity and imbued with the power to enact their vicious will on the multiverse. When you reach level 3, you gain one Eldritch Invocation of your choice from the Diabolical Gift table, or you can roll randomly. You ignore any prerequisites for your chosen Invocation.

entries.caption: Diabolical Gift table
footnotes: If your chosen invocation allows you to cast a spell, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for it (choose when you gain this trait).

entries.name: Divine Impetus
entries: The power of the vindivar's creator flows through you, even if you resist their influence over your mind. You have proficiency in the {@skill Religion|XPHB} and {@skill Stealth|XPHB} skills.

entries.name: Heretic Soul
entries: Either by gift of your creator, or by steely determination to wreak vengeance upon them, you are uniquely inured to the magic of the gods. Choose either Necrotic or Radiant damage. You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to the chosen damage type.

entries.name: Unshackled Will
entries: Your freedom from outside influence is not given; it is earned and kept daily through your unshakable drive to live freely. You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws you make to avoid or end the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} and {@condition Frightened|XPHB} conditions.

entries.name: Languages
entries: Your character can speak, read, and write Common and one other language that you and your GM agree is appropriate for the character.

sizeEntry.name: Size:
entries: Dukaput are a little larger than humans, with a sturdy, broad frame built to support two heads. Your size is Medium.

entries.name: Cognitive Contingency
entries: When you fall to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, you can choose to fall to 1 Hit Point instead. Doing so causes one of your heads to fall {@condition Unconscious|XPHB}. It remains so until you are restored to at least half of your maximum {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} (rounded up). You can use this trait only if both of your heads are conscious.

entries.name: Dukaput Magic
entries: You know the {@spell Minor Illusion|XPHB} cantrip. Starting at 3rd level, you can cast the {@spell Tasha's Hideous Laughter|XPHB|Hideous Laughter} spell with this trait. Starting at 5th level, you can also cast the {@spell Suggestion|XPHB} spell with this trait. Once you cast {@spell Tasha's Hideous Laughter|XPHB|Hideous Laughter} or {@spell Suggestion|XPHB} with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast either of those spells using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.
Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells when you cast them with this trait (choose when you select this species).

entries.name: Eyes and Ears
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on {@skill Perception|XPHB} checks.

entries.name: Telepathy
entries: You can send telepathic messages to creatures within 60 feet of you. An unwilling creature can choose to block your words from entering their mind.

entries.name: Twin Brain
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Constitution saving throws made to maintain {@status Concentration|XPHB} on a spell and on saving throws to avoid or end the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition.

entries.name: Watchful Rest
entries: When you sleep, each head can take turns resting while the other remains conscious. So long as you do not move, you can see and hear as normal while taking a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

sizeEntry.name: Size:
entries: Small (about 3-4 feet tall)

entries.name: Helpful
entries: When you take the {@action Help|XPHB} action, you can choose one willing creature within 5 feet of you to gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to your character level. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.
