entries.name: Surge of Power: Mind Into Matter
entries: When a hero rolls a natural 20 on an Attack roll or Ability Check while this wild magic surge is active, they find the power to bend it to their will. You can channel the potent wild magic of thought to create forms with your mind. For the next minute:

items: If your Intelligence score is lower than 19, it becomes 19.

You know the spells {@spell Mirror Image|XPHB} and {@spell Major Image|XPHB}, and can cast them as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} without a spell slot or components. The save DC for these spells is 8 + Intelligence Modifier + PB.

entries.name: Surge of Hope: Steady Mind
entries: When a hero rolls a natural 1 on an Attack roll, Ability Check, or Saving Throw while this wild magic surge is active, their moment of desperation spirals into The Weave, and it answers with new strength. You find a place of calm within your mind to weather the storm. For the next minute:

items: You are {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB|immune} to the Poisoning effect of this wild magic burst.
You {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB|resist} Psychic damage.
You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma Saving Throws, and on Saving Throws made to maintain {@status Concentration|XPHB}.

entries: Once a creature has triggered a Surge of Power or a Surge of Hope, they cannot do so again until they finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Wild Magic Bursts Round 2
entries: We're back with some more EXPLOSIVE expansions to combat! Are you ready to throw your party into an upside down world of chaos and power? Let's spice up combat with some more WILD MAGIC.

The concept here is simple: when your heroes roll for {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB}, a surge of wild magic washes over the battlefield. For this combat only, the laws of reality are turned on their head; new mechanics are introduced, and one monster of the GMs choice is imbued with the very essence of this wild magical phenomenon, growing even more terrifying. Don't worry though! Players can also harness the wild magic for themselves with wild magic surges of their own.

Below, you'll find three wild magic surges to use in your games - ways to elevate a combat encounter with fun new mechanics. Each one will also include a Surge of Power, a Surge of Hope, and a Monstrous Adaptation. The Monstrous Adaptation infuses one monster with the power of wild magic, and the players themselves can wield wild magic too via the surges of Power and Hope.

Some Wild Magic surges reference PB, which stands for {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}. In these cases, use the average {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} of the party (rounded down).

entries.name: Wild Magic of the Living Dead
entries: When players roll for {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB}, sinister, Necrotic Wild Magic creeps over the battlefield, feasting upon all living things. The flesh and sinew is stripped from the bones of all creatures on the battlefield as all nonmagical plants wither and waves of stinking corpses are conjured into existence. All creatures become undead and {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB|resist} Necrotic and Poison damage. Undead creatures cannot regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

entries.name: Monstrous Adaptation: Eternal Zombie
entries: When this wild magic surge activates, one {@variantrule Hostile [Attitude]|XPHB|Hostile} creature of the GMs choice undergoes a magical transformation. It is infused with the ravenous, entropic powers of undeath—a decaying, eternal monstrosity. It gains the following traits:

items: Its Intelligence and Charisma scores fall to 7 if they are higher.
Once per turn, when it deals damage to an undead creature, it gains PB {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}.
It has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Strength and Constitution Saving Throws.

If damage reduces it to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, it must make a Constitution Saving Throw with a DC of 5 + half the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB}. On a success, it falls to 1 hit point.

entries.name: Surge of Power: Death Caller
entries: When a hero rolls a natural 20 on an Attack roll or Ability Check while this wild magic surge is active, they find the power to call the dead to action. For the next minute:

items: The hollow eyes in your skull blaze with cruel, green light.

As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you cause a number of corpses up to your PB to spring to un-life under your command, which use the {@creature skeleton|XMM} stat block. They follow orders you give them (no action required) and take their turn immediately after yours. You can only control a number of undead equal to your PB at any given time with this surge.

entries.name: Surge of Hope: Warded
entries: When a hero rolls a natural 1 on an Attack roll, Ability Check, or Saving Throw while this wild magic surge is active, they find the inner strength to resist the cruel Necrotic magic around them. For the next minute:

items: You are {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB|immune} to the effects of this fount.
Undead creatures have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Attack rolls against you.
Undead cannot willingly move within 5 feet of you.

entries.name: Wild Magic of the Rising Dragon
entries: When players roll for {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB}, crackling and mighty Wild Magic heralds an oncoming force of unimaginable draconic power. On {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} count 20 each round, PB+1 kobolds appear in random, unoccupied spaces on the ground. They do not take actions, and chant in unison. If there are 8 or more kobolds on the battlefield chanting at the start of {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} count 20, a chromatic dragon of CR PB + 10 or lower appears and attacks all creatures on the battlefield indiscriminately.

entries.name: Monstrous Adaptation: Kobold Control
entries: When this wild magic surge activates, one {@variantrule Hostile [Attitude]|XPHB|Hostile} creature of the GMs choice undergoes a magical transformation. A creature with this adaptation draws strength from the draconic Wild Magic and the waves of kobolds it spawns. For the next minute:

items: While there are 2 or more kobolds on the battlefield, it has a +PB bonus to Ability Checks.
While there are 4 or more kobolds on the battlefield, it has a +PB bonus to Attack rolls.
While there are 6 or more kobolds on the battlefield, it has a +PB bonus to Saving Throws.
While there are 8 or more kobolds on the battlefield, it is {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB|immune} to Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning and Poison damage, and it has a +PB bonus to AC.

entries.name: Surge of Power: Kobold Crusher
entries: When a hero rolls a natural 20 on an Attack roll or Ability Check while this wild magic surge is active, the threat of an oncoming dragon spurs them to incredible action. For the next minute:

items: When you damage a kobold as a part of your action, you can take one additional action that turn.
You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Attack rolls made against kobolds.

entries.name: Surge of Hope: Draconic Boon
entries: When a hero rolls a natural 1 on an Attack roll, Ability Check, or Saving Throw while this wild magic surge is active, the chromatic lineage of dragons burns through their body. For the next minute:

items: You grow a pair of spectral, draconic wings. You have a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} equal to your walking {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}.
At the start of your turn, choose one damage type from among Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Poison. Until the start of your next turn, you {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB|resist} that damage type.

entries.name: Wild Magic of Raging Giants
entries: When players roll for {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB}, an eruption of Wild Magic infuses every creature with the fortitude and size of a giant. If there is room, creatures grow to Huge in size, their reach increases by 10 feet, they have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Strength checks and Saving Throws, and their Strength-based weapon attacks deal an additional {@damage 1d4} damage.

entries.name: Monstrous Adaptation: Stone Giant's Fortification
entries: When this wild magic surge activates, one {@variantrule Hostile [Attitude]|XPHB|Hostile} creature of the GMs choice undergoes a magical transformation. A creature with this monstrous adaptation is fortified with the iron will and skin of Stone Giants. It gains the following traits:

items: Its size increases to maximum size for the space, up to Gargantuan.
Its weapon attacks deal an additional {@damage 1d4} damage.
It {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB|resist}s Bludgeoning, Piercing, and damage.
As a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} when hit by an attack, it can gain a PB bonus to its AC until the end of the turn, as its skin hardens to stone.

entries.name: Surge of Power: Fire Giant's Fury
entries: When a hero rolls a natural 20 on an Attack roll or Ability Check while this wild magic surge is active, the fury of the Fire giants lends strength to their transformation. For the next minute:

items: Once per turn, when you damage a creature, you can choose to deal an additional PBd8 Fire damage to that target.
You {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB|resist} Fire damage.
Creatures {@condition Grappled|XPHB|grappled} by you take {@damage 1d10} Fire damage at the start of each of their turns.

entries.name: Surge of Hope: Ice Giant's Resilience
entries: When a hero rolls a natural 1 on an Attack roll, Ability Check, or Saving Throw while this wild magic surge is active, the mighty resilience of the ice giants finds a home within them. For the next minute:

items: You {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB|resist} Cold and Fire damage.
Your AC increases by PB, as a chilling vortex of ice and snow spirals around you.
If a creature within 15 feet of you targets you with a melee weapon attack, that creature cannot move until the start of its next turn, as the icy vortex surrounding you briefly freezes it in place.

entries.name: Wild Magic Bursts Round 3
entries: One more time into the breach, everyone! The universe is collapsing, the rules of physics and biology are turning upside down, and you're caught in the middle of everything while fighting for your life against an overweight green dragon. Let's spice up combat with some more WILD MAGIC.

The concept here is simple: when your heroes roll for {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB}, a surge of wild magic washes over the battlefield. For this combat only, the laws of reality are turned on their head; new mechanics are introduced, and one monster of the GMs choice is imbued with the very essence of this wild magical phenomenon, growing even more terrifying. Don't worry though! Players can also harness the wild magic for themselves with wild magic surges of their own.

Below, you'll find three wild magic surges to use in your games - ways to elevate a combat encounter with fun new mechanics. Each one will also include a Surge of Power, a Surge of Hope, and a Monstrous Adaptation. The Monstrous Adaptation infuses one monster with the power of wild magic, and the players themselves can wield wild magic too via the surges of Power and Hope.

Some Wild Magic surges reference PB, which stands for {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}. In these cases, use the average {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} of the party (rounded down).

If you've enjoyed these Wild Magic expansions, I made a deck of cards full of them you can draw and use in your games! {@link Check it out here!|https://dndshorts.myshopify.com/products/the-game-masters-deck-of-boons-and-banes}

entries.name: Wild Magic of Force
entries: Wild Magic is power in its rawest form, and damage in its rawest form is force. All damage rolls deal an additional PB Force damage. The first time a creature is dealt Force damage on a turn, it must succeed on a DC 12 + PB Saving Throw or be pushed 10 feet directly away from the source of the damage.

entries.name: Surge of Power: One with the Force
entries: The rapturous power of Wild Magic charges through you. For the next minute:

items: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can cast the {@spell magic missile|XPHB} spell (level 1) without a spell slot or components.
Creatures {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB|immune} to Force damage instead take half damage from your spells and attacks that deal Force damage.

entries.name: Surge of Hope: Focused Force
entries: The crackling Wild Magic of pure force sharpens your mind and heightens your awareness. For the next minute:

items: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Dexterity Saving Throws.
Creatures have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Attack rolls against you.

entries.name: Monstrous Adaptation: Shimmering Shield
entries: A creature with this monstrous adaptation is hardened and inured to the harmful powers of Wild Magic. It gains the following traits:

items: {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB|I mmune} to Force damage.
AC increases by 2 if it has dealt Force damage to a creature since the start of its last turn.

entries.name: Wild Magic of Howling Wind
entries: A riotous hurricane batters the battlefield. The GM rolls {@dice 1d4} to determine the direction of the wind: 1. North, 2. East, 3. South, 4. West. On {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} count 20, all creatures must succeed on a Strength Saving Throw or be pushed 5 x PB feet in the direction of the wind. Airborne creatures make this Saving Throw at {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}. If a creature is pushed into another creature or object, both it and the creature/object it strikes take PBd4 Bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Surge of Power: Wind Rider
entries: Blessed with the Wild Magic of the wind, you are fleet-footed and joyous in the midst of the hurricane. For the next minute:

items: You have a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} equal to twice your walking {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}.
Your movement doesn't provoke {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks}.
You automatically succeed on Saving Throws to avoid being moved against your will by wind.

entries.name: Surge of Hope: Anchoring Roots
entries: As ferociously as Wild Magic conjures an obstacle, it is just as likely to conjure a shield. Anchoring roots burst from the earth and fortify you against the gale and incoming attacks. For the next minute:

items: You cannot be moved or knocked {@condition Prone|XPHB} against your will.
You gain {@sense Tremorsense|XPHB} out to 30 feet.
Attack rolls against you cannot be made with {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}.

entries.name: Monstrous Adaptation: Hurricane Blessed
entries: A creature with this monstrous adaptation is one with the cruel chaos of the howling wind. It gains the following features:

items: It automatically succeeds on Saving Throws to avoid being moved against its will by the wind.
It has a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} equal to walking {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}.
The creature has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Attack rolls against non-airborne creatures while it is airborne.
It can use its {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to make a single melee weapon attack against any creature that leaves its reach, even if the creature leaves unwillingly.

entries.name: Wild Magic of Drowning Rain
entries: Icy, torrential rain cascades in endless sheets onto the battlefield. All creatures {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB|resist} Fire damage, nonmagical flames are extinguished and the ground becomes {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} for any creature without a {@variantrule Swim Speed|XPHB}. In addition, Attack rolls that deal Lightning damage on a hit have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}, and creatures have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Saving Throws to avoid Lightning damage.

entries.name: Surge of Power: Storm Thrower
entries: Wild Magic has blessed this battlefield with water and blessed you with the power to make it electrifying. For the next minute:

items: Your weapon attacks deal an additional {@damage 1d6} Lightning damage on a hit.
Whenever you cast a spell that deals Acid, Cold, Fire, Poison or Thunder damage, you can change the damage type to Lightning.

entries.name: Surge of Hope: Waterborne
entries: Far from a threat, the endless water around you feels like home. For the next minute:

items: You have a {@variantrule Swim Speed|XPHB} equal to your walking {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}.
You {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB|resist} Lightning and Cold damage.
While it is raining, you can use your {@variantrule Swim Speed|XPHB} to move through the air. If the rain stops while you are airborne, you fall.

entries.name: Monstrous Adaptation: Stormborne
entries: A creature with this monstrous adaptation rumbles with the Thunderous fury of drowning storms, gaining the following features:

items: It gains a {@variantrule Swim Speed|XPHB} equal to its walking {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}.
It is {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB|immune} to Cold and Lightning damage.
Its Attack rolls and spells deal an additional {@damage 1d6} Lightning damage.
Once per turn, when it deals Lightning damage to a creature, all other creatures within 10 feet of that creature take PB x 2 Lightning damage.

entries.name: Core Rules
entries: Spire Mode D&D is an easy to prepare, varied, and challenging adventure for heroes of any level, though a party of at least level 3 is recommended. The premise is simple: the heroes must ascend a spire guarded with multiple puzzles, monsters, and evil forces to reach and defeat the tyrant that dwells on the highest floor.
A Spire includes 15 floors. Each floor contains a Puzzle Room, Battle Room or a Deadly Bargain, and due to the indecipherable, shifting magic of the Spire, the order of floors are random.

The only exceptions are Floor 15, which is always the floor containing the Final Boss, and Floor 8, which is always the Rest Room. Heroes who enter the Rest Room can relieve themselves (by taking a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}).

entries.name: Puzzle Floors
entries: Puzzle Floors contain puzzles that the heroes must solve in a given time limit. Players who fail to solve the room in the given time or solve the puzzle incorrectly take damage according to each floor's fail condition. Heroes who complete a puzzle room with more than half the time remaining receive a random potion each of a rarity that matches their {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}. 2 = Common, 3 = Uncommon, 4 = Rare, 5+ = Very Rare.

entries.name: Battle Floors
entries: Battle Floors contain a random combat encounter containing at least one enemy. All enemies within a Battle Floor have a total CR equal to the party's level minus half their proficiency bonus (rounded down). A level 5 party would battle enemies totalling CR 4, while a level 17 party would battle enemies totaling CR 14, for example. For a party of more or fewer than four heroes, GMs should adjust these values accordingly to ensure a Medium difficulty encounter.

The Spire need not adhere to laws of space, time, and physics. GM's should feel free to treat each floor as its own demiplane, using any map that inspires the imagination for battle. Three sample Battle Floor battlemaps are included on page 30, page 31, and page 32

entries.name: Deadly Bargain Floors
entries: Deadly Bargain Floors offer heroes a gambling chance. They can obtain great power to aid in ascending the tower, but risk a significant drawback if fate is not on their side. A list of eight Deadly Bargains heroes might encounter as they ascend the spire can be found on page 23, though GMs are encouraged to create their own too!

entries.name: Final Boss Floor
entries: The Final Boss Floor contains the leader of the Spire, a creature of CR equal to the level of the highest levelled hero plus that hero's {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}

entries.name: A Spire Adventure
entries: This expansion includes five puzzles for the Puzzle Floors and eight Deadly Bargains. You can use puzzles found in previous expansions to add more puzzle rooms and variation to spires and include additional random combat encounters and add additional Battle Floors and Rest Rooms if you'd like to lengthen the spire or add to the challenge.
A Spire Mode adventure using material given in this expansion might look like this (Estimated Game Time 3 hours).

entries.name: Deadly Bargains
entries: A Deadly Bargain Room is empty, save for an otherworldly presence that offers a deal to the heroes. Heroes cannot stay in a Deadly Bargain room for more than 3 minutes. If they have not made a decision in that time, they receive a random option.
Any boons or banes gained from a Deadly Bargain end when the hero exits the Spire.

entries.name: Barbarian's Bargain
entries: Each hero makes a choice from the following bargains.

items.name: Bring It On
entries: You lose all damage {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB|resist} and {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB|Immunities}, cannot gain damage {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} or {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB}, and have {@variantrule Vulnerability|XPHB} to all damage. Triple your Maximum {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and gain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the number your Maximum {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} increased by.

items.name: Brain Off, Biceps On
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving hrows, and {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Wisdom and Intelligence Saving Throws.

entries.name: Demon's Bargain
entries: Each hero makes a choice from the following bargains.

items.name: Fiendish Gamble
entries: Roll {@dice 1d20}. On an 11 or above, you gain a number of {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to twice your Level. On a 10 or below, you lose {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to twice your character level.

items.name: Power at Price
entries: Half your {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point Maximum}. The next two times you make an Attack roll, you score an automatic {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB}. The next two times you force a creature to make a Saving Throw, one target of that Saving Throw of your choice automatically fails.

entries.name: Celestial's Bargain
entries: Each hero makes a choice from the following bargains.

items.name: Pacifism
entries: You have +2 bonus to your AC. You have a -3 penalty to damage rolls.

items.name: Insurance Policy
entries: The first time you would fall to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, you fall to 1 instead, and then regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to twice your character level. Enemies have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Attack rolls against you while you are not {@status Bloodied|XPHB}.

entries.name: Fighter's Bargain
entries: Each hero makes a choice from the following bargains.

items.name: Surge!
entries: Whenever you reduce a creature to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} on your turn, you can take one additional action. If you end a combat encounter without having reduced at least one creature to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, gain a point of {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB}.

items.name: Horde Crusher
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Attack rolls, and you gain a bonus to your AC equal to the number of {@variantrule Hostile [Attitude]|XPHB|Hostile} enemies within 60 feet of you that aren't {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB}. You cannot attack the same creature more than once per turn.

entries.name: Giant's Bargain
entries: Each hero makes a choice from the following bargains.

items.name: Bully
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Attack rolls against creatures that are your size category or smaller. You are {@condition Frightened|XPHB} of creatures at least one size category larger than you.

items.name: Welcome to the Big Time
entries: You are permanently under the effects of the {@spell Enlarge/Reduce|XPHB} spell. Whenever you roll {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB}, you lose {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to twice your level.

entries.name: Ranger's Bargain
entries: The party vote on which Deadly Bargain to take as a group.

items.name: Easy Prey
entries: Creatures in the next Battle Room begin combat at half their maximum {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. The CR of the creature in the Boss Room increases by 3.

items.name: Tyrant's Minions
entries: The next Battle Room becomes a Rest Room instead. The creature in the Boss Room is now accompanied by at least four allied creatures, whose total CR equals the party level.

entries.name: Sorcerer's Bargain
entries: Each hero makes a choice from the following bargains.

items.name: Desperate Spellcasting
entries: You can only expend 1 {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB|Hit Die} to recover HP when you {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB}, and any time you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB} you regain a number of expended spell slots of combined level equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} +1.

items.name: Brazen Bravery
entries: You have a +2 bonus to Attack Rolls, and you have {@variantrule Vulnerability|XPHB} to a random damage type from among Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Thunder (roll {@dice 1d6} to determine which one).

entries.name: Spire's Bargain
entries: The party vote on which Deadly Bargain to take as a group.

items.name: Big Army, Small Tyrant
entries: All subsequent Deadly Bargain Floors are Battle Floors instead. The Final Boss's CR is reduced by an amount equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}.

items.name: Get Lucky
entries: Whenever you enter a floor that isn't the Final Boss floor, roll {@dice 1d20}. On a 20, the floor becomes a Rest Room instead. The Final Boss's CR is increased by 1.

baseitem.name: Tower Shield
entries: A tower shield is made from wood or metal and is carried with both hands. Due to its cumbersome size and weight, a creature wielding a tower shield must expend 2 feet of movement for every 1 foot it moves.

Wielding a tower shield increases your Armour Class by 5, and if you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity saving throw to take only half damage, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw, interposing your shield between yourself and the source of the effect. You can benefit from only one shield at a time.

entries.name: Special
entries: When you are hit by an attack roll, you can use a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to attempt to catch the blow with the buckler. Roll {@dice 1d4} and add the result to your AC for that attack, potentially causing the attack to miss you.

item.name: Familiar's Magic Barding
entries: This tiny, delicate armour morphs in size and form to suit the shape of a familiar. A familiar can don or doff the armour as an action.
While a familiar is wearing this armour, its AC becomes equal to 14 + the {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} of the mage who summoned it.

When a creature bearing this armour takes damage, it can use its {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to absorb that damage into the armour instead. Once this property of the armour has been used, it cannot be used again for 12 hours, over which time the armour safely discharges the energy it captured.

item.name: Bottled Faerie
entries: This innocuous, corked glass bottle holds the spirit fragment of a mighty celestial, manifested in the form of a small fairy within.

As an action, you can uncork the bottle and release the spirit within, which spirals around you in a helix of light and drifting embers. Your {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} are restored to full, and you gain a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} equal to your walking {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} for the next minute. The spirit then departs, leaving only the ordinary, glass bottle behind.

If you fall to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} while this bottle is on your person, its effect automatically triggers (no action required), and you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to immediately stand up from {@condition Prone|XPHB}.

item.name: Phoenix Down
entries: This small phoenix feather is warm to the touch and thrums with potent resurrection magic.

As an action, you can place the feather on an {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} creature with 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or the corpse of a creature that has been dead for less than 24 hours. The feather magically ignites, burning to ash and imparting its magic to the target.

If the target was an {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} creature, it regains {@dice 1d10} {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and can use its {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to stand up from {@condition Prone|XPHB} and make a single weapon attack, or stand up from {@condition Prone|XPHB} and move half its movement {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks}.

If the target is a corpse of a creature that died within the last 24 hours, that creature returns to life with 5 points of {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} and regains {@dice 1d10} {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

item.name: Helm of the Demon Lord
entries: This helm is fashioned in the shape of a ram's skull.

entries.name: Cursed Truesight
entries: Upon attuning to the helm, your natural body is {@condition Blinded|XPHB} until your attunement ends. The helm then shares its awareness with you; you have {@sense Truesight|XPHB} out to 120 feet of the helm. This vision is tied to the helm's location, not your own.

entries.name: Demon's Command
entries: The helm has 4 charges. As an action, you can expend 1 charge to cast {@spell Word of the Demon Lord|DMSecretWeapon24} (save {@dc 17}). Each time you kill a worthy foe, roll {@dice 1d6}. On a 6, the helm regains one expended charge.

entries.name: Vile Curse
entries: You automatically fail saving throws to resist the spells and effects of demons of CR 20 or above, and you are unwilling to part with the helm, opting to wear it all times. These effects are suppressed for 24 hours if the helm is targeted by a {@spell Remove Curse|XPHB} spell cast at 6th level or above.

entries.name: Special Property: Demonic Restoration
entries: While attuned to the Helm of the Demon Lord, {@item Demon's Plate|DMSecretWeapon24}, and {@item Demon Lord's Escutcheon|DMSecretWeapon24}, you gain the following benefit. If you would die outside the Abyss, your body and everything you are wearing and carrying instead dissolves into black tar, and you gain a new body instantly, reviving with all your {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} somewhere in the Abyss. Once you have been revived in this way, you cannot be revived in such a way again for {@dice 1d100} days.

item.name: Demon's Plate
entries: This plate mail is forever icy to the touch. You resist Cold, Fire, and Lightning damage. You are immune to Necrotic damage.

Additionally, when you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action, you can cast the spell {@spell Demonic Roulette|DMSecretWeapon24} in place of one attack. Once this property of the Demon's Plate has been used, it cannot be used again until the next dawn.

item.name: Demon Lord's Escutcheon
entries: This spiked shield bears the sigil of a terrifying demon who's name is lost to the mortal world. It has 6 charges. As an action, you can expend 1 charge to cast {@spell Animate Dead|XPHB}, or expend 5 charges to cast {@spell Create Undead|XPHB}, even if it is not night time. The shield regains {@dice 1d6} charges each dusk.

When you take damage, you can use a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to cause a {@creature Ghoul|XMM}, {@creature Skeleton|XMM}, or {@creature Zombie|XMM} within 30 feet of you to disintegrate, as its vile energies are torn from its form and spring to your defense. You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to all damage until the end of this turn (including the triggering damage).

item.name: Eidolon Stone: Shimmering Topaz
entries: While attuned to this gemstone, you resist Fire damage.

As an action, you can expend a 3rd level spell slot to summon a {@creature Fire Elemental|XMM}. It is {@variantrule Friendly [Attitude]|XPHB|Friendly} to you and your companions and takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your commands (no action required). When the elemental is summoned, roll {@dice 1d4}. The elemental vanishes after taking a number of turns equal to the result on the d4.
Once this property of the Topaz has been used, it cannot be used again until the next dawn.

item.name: Eidolon Stone: Shimmering Opal
entries: While attuned to this gemstone, you resist Cold damage.

As an action, you can expend a 3rd level spell slot to summon a {@creature Water Elemental|XMM}. It is {@variantrule Friendly [Attitude]|XPHB|Friendly} to you and your companions and takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your commands (no action required). When the elemental is summoned, roll {@dice 1d4}. The elemental vanishes after taking a number of turns equal to the result on the d4.
Once this property of the opal has been used, it cannot be used again until the next dawn.

item.name: Eidolon Stone: Shimmering Amber
entries: While attuned to this gemstone, you have a +1 bonus to your AC.

As an action, you can expend a 5th level spell slot to summon a {@creature Treant|XMM}. It is {@variantrule Friendly [Attitude]|XPHB|Friendly} to you and your companions and takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your commands (no action required). When the treant is summoned, roll {@dice 1d6}. The treant vanishes after taking a number of turns equal to the result on the {@dice d6}.
Once this property of the amber has been used, it cannot be used again until the next dawn.

item.name: Eidolon Stone: Shimmering Garnet
entries: While attuned to this gemstone, you resist bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

As an action, you can expend an 8th level spell slot to summon an {@creature Adult Gold Dragon|XMM}. It is {@variantrule Friendly [Attitude]|XPHB|Friendly} to you and your companions and takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your commands (no action required). When the dragon is summoned, roll {@dice 1d6}. The dragon vanishes after taking a number of turns equal to the result on the d6.
Once this property of the garnet has been used, it cannot be used again until the next dawn.

item.name: Eidolon Stone: Shimmering Jet
entries: While attuned to this gemstone, you resist Necrotic damage.

As an action, you can expend a 3rd level spell slot to summon a {@creature Wraith|XMM}. It is {@variantrule Friendly [Attitude]|XPHB|Friendly} to you and your companions and takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your commands (no action required). When the wraith is summoned, roll {@dice 1d4}. The wraith vanishes after taking a number of turns equal to the result on the d4.
Once this property of the jet has been used, it cannot be used again until the next dawn.

item.name: Eidolon Stone: Shimmering Sapphire
entries: While attuned to this gemstone, you resist Radiant damage.

As an action, you can expend a 3rd level spell slot to summon a {@creature Unicorn|XMM}. It is {@variantrule Friendly [Attitude]|XPHB|Friendly} to you and your companions and takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your commands (no action required). When the unicorn is summoned, roll {@dice 1d4}. The unicorn vanishes after taking a number of turns equal to the result on the d4.
Once this property of the sapphire has been used, it cannot be used again until the next dawn.

item.name: Eidolon Stone: Shimmering Diamond
entries: While attuned to this gemstone, you resist bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage

As an action, you can expend an 8th level spell slot to summon a {@creature Planetar|XMM}. It is {@variantrule Friendly [Attitude]|XPHB|Friendly} to you and your companions and takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your commands (no action required). When the planetar is summoned, roll {@dice 1d6}. The planetar vanishes after taking a number of turns equal to the result on the d6.
Once this property of the diamond has been used, it cannot be used again until the next dawn.

item.name: Pumice
entries: While attuned to this rock, you gain a bonus to Ability Checks and Saving Throws equal to the number of Eidolon Stones you are attuned to.
Additionally, treat any result on a die rolled to determine how many rounds a creature from a Eidolon Stone lasts as the maximum possible roll.

item.name: Levitation Shield
entries: This shield murmurs with gravitational magic. It has 3 charges. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can expand 1 of the shield's charges to gain a 30 foot {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} for the next minute. During this time, you are also immune to the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition and can hover.

item.name: Aberration Plate
entries: This sinister suit of armour oozes a ravenous aura of antimagic. It has 3 charges. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can expend 1 of the armour's charges to cast {@spell Dispel Magic|XPHB} as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, using your Constitution for the spellcasting modifier.

item.name: Helm of Beholding
entries: This helm writhes with undulating tentacles, each of which cradles a watchful eye at the tip. It has 4 charges. While wearing the helm, you can expend 1 of its charges (no action required) to channel its magic for 1 hour, or until you doff the helm, during which time you gain {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} out to 120 feet, and you gain a +10 bonus to Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks based on sight.

entries.name: Special Property: Tyrant's Wrath
entries: While attuned to the Helm of Beholding, {@item Levitation Shield|DMSecretWeapon24}, and {@item Aberration Plate|DMSecretWeapon24}, when you damage a creature with an attack roll or spell, you can expend one charge from any item you are attuned to. When you do so, roll on the Tyrant's Wrath table below; the target suffers an additional effect depending on your result, as a beam of hateful magic surges from this helm towards them. Once this property of the helm has been used, it cannot be used again until the start of your next turn.

entries.caption: Tyrant's Wrath
rows: The target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition Charmed|XPHB} by you for 1 minute, or until you or an ally deals damage to it.
The target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw or be {@condition Paralyzed|XPHB} until the end of its next turn.

The target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or be {@condition Frightened|XPHB} for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

The target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the target's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is halved for 1 minute. In addition, the creature can't take {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB|reactions}, and it can take either an {@variantrule Action|XPHB} or a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on its turn, not both. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
The target must make a {@dc 16} Constitution saving throw, taking 36 ({@damage 8d8}) Necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a {@dc 16} Strength saving throw or be moved up to 30 feet in any direction of your choice. It is then held in place and {@condition Restrained|XPHB} until the start of your next turn.

The target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Wisdom saving throw or fall asleep and remain {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} for 1 minute. The target awakens if it takes damage or another creature takes an {@variantrule Action|XPHB} to wake it.

The target must make a {@dc 16} Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is banished to a harmless demiplane until the end of its next turn, reappearing in the nearest unoccupied space to where it left.
The target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Intelligence saving throw or take 28 ({@damage 6d8}) Psychic damage.
The target must succeed on a {@dc 16} Dexterity saving throw or take 35 ({@damage 6d10}) Necrotic damage.

item.name: Filiform Needles
entries: Manufacturing: {@item Smith's Tools|XPHB}; 3 {@item Copper|XDMG|CP} materials; 1/2 hour
Filiform Needles are incredibly fine and viciously sharp tools that can be used as weapons. They also have the {@itemMastery Hamstring|RyokoGuideToYokaiRealms|Hamstring Superior Strike}{@sup *}.
{@note {@sup *}If using Advanced Weapon Mastery from {@loader Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realms|collection/Loot Tavern; Ryoko's Guide to the Yokai Realms.json}}

item.name: Sneezing Beret
entries: This handsome beret lets out an occasional sneeze. It has 4 charges, and regains 1d4 charges each dawn.

As a bonus action, the wearer can expend a charge to incite the beret to sneeze a glob of viscous acid at a creature within 30 feet. That target must succeed on a {@dc 14} Dexterity saving throw or take {@damage 2d10} acid damage.

item.name: Counterfeit Demon Wand
entries: This simple wand is cheaply made in the image of an ancient and terrifying artefact of power. It can be used as a spellcasting focus by any Sorcerer, Wizard, or Warlock, or any spellcaster with demonic heritage.
When used as a spellcasting focus, the wielder can add +1 to the attack and damage rolls of spell attacks that target Fiends that aren't demons.
You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

entries.name: Dig
entries: As an action, you can grant yourself a {@variantrule Burrow Speed|XPHB} equal to half your walking {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} until the end of your next turn, as you use the Shovel Blade to carve a path through the earth.

entries.name: Shovel Drop
entries: When you fall more than 10 feet and aren't {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB}, you can use a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to maneuver the pressure of your impact into the blade.

If you land on the ground, subtract {@dice 10d6} from the fall damage you take. If you land on a creature, it takes any fall damage you would have taken from the fall, and you land in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of it.

entries.name: Spark Thrust
entries: As an action, you can spin this magic shovel in the earth at your feet to generate a magical static charge, which then propels along the ground in a {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line} 15-feet long and 5-feet wide. Creatures in that area must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC = 8 + your Dexterity or Strength modifier + {@variantrule Proficiency Bonus|XPHB}), taking {@damage 3d10} Lightning damage on a failed save.

feat.name: Splatterproof
entries: Be it through experience in masterful acrobatics or dismal flying, you are well accustomed to taking large falls.

items: When you fall, you can subtract up to 100 feet from your fall when calculating your fall damage.

When you fall more than 20 feet and do not take fall damage, you can use a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} upon landing to make a single melee weapon attack against a creature within your reach. On a hit, that attack deals an additional {@damage 1d4} bludgeoning damage for every 20 feet you fell, to a maximum of {@damage 5d4}. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, regaining all expended uses upon finishing a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

feat.name: Bloodsoaked Victory
entries: In times of crisis, you draw on your own body as a final bastion of desperate power. You gain the following benefits:

items: When you miss an attack roll, you can use a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to expend {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} in multiples of 5, to a maximum of 5 × your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}. Your maximum {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} are reduced by the same amount until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. For every 5 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} you expend, you gain a +1 bonus to your attack, potentially turning a miss into a hit.

feat.name: Lifestream Reservoir
entries: The steady pulse of life that runs through your body is a resource that you can draw upon in times of need. You gain the following benefits:

items: When you restore {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} to a creature with a spell, feature, or item, you can expend one {@variantrule Hit Dice|XPHB|Hit Die}. Roll it, and the target gains additional {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the result.

When you fail a {@variantrule d20 Test|XPHB}, you can use a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to expend one {@variantrule Hit Dice|XPHB|Hit Die}. Roll it, and add the result to your roll, potentially turning a failure into success. Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

feat.name: Ranged Weapon Fighting
entries: When you roll a natural 1 on an attack roll made with a Ranged weapon, you can reroll it at {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}, but you must use the new roll.

feat.name: Ferocious Striker
entries: When you score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} on an attack roll made with a weapon or an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, you can roll two additional damage dice and add them to the total damage dealt.

feat.name: Executioner's Strike
entries: When you hit a {@condition Prone|XPHB} creature with an attack using a Melee weapon, you score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} on a roll of 19 or 20 on the {@dice d20}.

feat.name: Mounted Fighting
entries: A mount under your control gains the following benefits while you are mounted on it and neither of you are {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB}.

items: Its movement {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} increases by 10 feet
It can use its {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to make a single attack immediately before or after it takes the {@action Dash|XPHB}, {@action Disengage|XPHB}, or {@action Dodge|XPHB} action

feat.name: Elemental Nullifier
entries: To you, the form of magic is nothing more than a crude colouring that decorates primal force.

items: You can change the damage type of any spell you cast that deals Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Thunder, or Poison damage to force damage instead.

feat.name: Retributive Surge
entries: The virtuosity and good fortune of your enemies inspires you to perform phenomenal acts of your own.

items: When a creature scores a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} against you and you aren't {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB}, you can take one additional action on your next turn. Once you use this feature, you cannot do so again until {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

feat.name: Raging Spirit
entries: In moments of desperation, you are able to call upon resolve and power you thought impossible.

items: While {@status Bloodied|XPHB}, you gain a bonus to the damage rolls of your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes} and weapon attacks equal to half your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}.

feat.name: Potent Potioneer
entries: Be it a quirk of magic or physiology, potions have a very potent effect on you.

items: You gain proficiency in {@item Brewer's Supplies|XPHB}.

When you drink a {@item Potion of Healing|XDMG}, {@item Potion of Greater Healing|XDMG|Greater Healing}, or {@item Potion of Superior Healing|XDMG|Superior Healing}, treat any dice rolled to restore your {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} as the maximum possible.
When you drink a potion that does not restore your {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, you regain a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to your Constitution modifier.

feat.name: Built Different
entries: Your heritage confers both social and physiological advantages.

items: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Charisma checks made to interact with creatures that share your creature type.

feat.name: Superior Shapeshifter
entries: You specialise in the druidic art of shapeshifting, granting you the following benefits.

items: When you Wild Shape, you can transform into a creature with a CR equal as high as ¼ your Druid level, and you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Constitution saves while Wild Shaped.

feat.name: Fury Strikes
entries: Your boundless rage empowers your strikes. While you are raging, your {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} threshold for attack rolls made with melee weapons and {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes} is reduced by 1.

feat.name: Initiate of the Dragon
entries: You gain the following benefits:

entries.name: Dragontongue
entries: You understand and can speak {@language Draconic|XPHB}.

entries.name: Greatwyrm's Favour
entries: Choose one type of dragon from among Chromatic, Gem, or Metallic. You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on skill checks made to recall information about the chosen type, and have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Charisma checks made to interact with dragons of the chosen type, or folk who worship them.

entries.name: Summoner
entries: You know the spell {@spell Find Familiar|XPHB}, and can cast it once per day as a {@variantrule Ritual|XPHB} without components. When you cast it in this way, you can choose to summon a {@creature Sparking Wyrmling|DMSecretWeapon24}. (See page 14)

feat.name: Gale of the Topaz Gem Dragon
entries: You possess the guarded mind and mastery of enervating magic of the topaz dragons, granting the following benefits.

items: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can conjure a gale of desiccating fog in a 15-foot {@variantrule Cone|XPHB|cone}. Creatures of your choice in that area must succeed on a Constitution saving throw (DC = 8 + twice your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}) or have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Strength-based ability checks and saving throws, and suffer a penalty to Strength-based damage rolls equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} until the end of your next turn. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, regaining all expended uses upon finishing a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

feat.name: Insight of the Emerald Gem Dragon
entries: You possess the sparkling intellect and striking insight of the emerald dragons, granting the following benefits.

items: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can grant yourself a {@variantrule Burrow Speed|XPHB} equal to your walking {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} until the end of this turn, leaving a 5-foot tunnel in your wake. When you burrow using this feature, you can burrow through solid rock at half-speed. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and regain all expended uses upon finishing a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

feat.name: Psionics of the Sapphire Gem Dragon
entries: You possess the tactical mastery and innate psionics of the sapphire dragons, granting the following benefits.

items: You know the {@spell Vicious Mockery|XPHB} and {@spell Minor Illusion|XPHB} cantrips. Constitution, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability when you cast them (choose when you gain this feat).

As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can focus your mind to generate psionic power. The first spell you cast before the end of your next turn can be cast without verbal or somatic components. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and regain all expended uses upon finishing a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

feat.name: Radiance of the Crystal Gem Dragon
entries: You possess the effortless charm and beguiling wit of the crystal dragons, granting the following benefits.

items: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can conjure up rays of brilliant radiance that engulf up to two creatures you can see that are within 15 feet of each other. Any creature caught in a ray must succeed on a Constitution saving throw (DC = 8 + twice your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}) or take Xd4 Radiant damage, where X is equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}. You then gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to half the Radiant damage dealt in this way. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and regain all expended uses upon finishing a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

feat.name: Warp of the Amethyst Gem Dragon
entries: You possess the regality and wisdom of the amethyst dragons, granting the following benefits.

items: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can choose one unoccupied space you can see within 60 feet of you. You exist in your own space and the chosen space simultaneously until the end of your next turn. Whenever you move or take an action, you choose which version of yourself is moving or acting. If an effect or attack can target both of your spaces at the same time, you are only affected once. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, regaining all expended uses upon finishing a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

feat.name: Vassal of the Gem Dragon God

feat: gale of the topaz gem dragon|DMSecretWeapon24
insight of the emerald gem dragon|DMSecretWeapon24
psionics of the sapphire gem dragon|DMSecretWeapon24
radiance of the crystal gem dragon|DMSecretWeapon24
warp of the amethyst gem dragon|DMSecretWeapon24

entries: You are a shining singularity of crystalline, psionic energy. Your incredible draconic power offers the following benefits.

items: On your turn, you can take one additional {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. You can use this feature only once per turn, and up to a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}. You regain all expended uses upon finishing a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.
You have a {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to Force, Necrotic, Psychic, Radiant, and Thunder damage.

You have a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB|Flying Speed}, {@variantrule Swim Speed|XPHB|Swimming Speed}, and {@variantrule Climb Speed|XPHB|Climbing Speed} equal to your walking {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}.
You have {@sense Blindsight|XPHB} out to 60 feet, and {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} out to 120 feet.
You have a Legendary Resistance. Once per {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, if you fail a saving throw, you can choose to succeed instead.

feat.name: Barbarian's Rampage
entries: Your training embraces the fury at the heart of what it is to be a barbarian, granting you the following benefits.

items: You can use your Strength modifier in place of your Dexterity modifier when calculating your Unarmored Defense.

The first time you hit a creature with a melee attack on your turn, if you attacked Recklessly, the target is {@condition Frightened|XPHB} of you until the end of its next turn. You can use this feature a number of times equal to the modifier of the stat you increased with this feat, regaining all expended uses upon finishing a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

feat.name: Rogue's Cunning
entries: Your training embraces the agility and cunning at the heart of what it is to be a rogue, granting you the following benefits.

items: When you deal damage with your Sneak Attack, you deal additional damage equal to the modifier of the stat you increased with this feat.

When you use your Cunning Action, you can choose two options, not one, from among the {@action Dash|XPHB}, {@action Disengage|XPHB}, or {@action Hide|XPHB} options. You can use this feature a number of times equal to the modifier of the stat you increased with this feat, regaining all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

feat.name: Fighter's Onslaught
entries: Your training embraces the speed and technique at the heart of what it is to be a fighter, granting you the following benefits.

items: When you Action Surge, you can perform two additional actions this turn, but you cannot take the same action twice as part of the Action Surge.
When you Second Wind, you can add the modifier of the stat you increased with this feat to the {@dice 1d10} rolled.

feat.name: Frost Giant's War Cry
entries: You possess the cunning battlemastery of a frost giant.

items: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you or one creature of your choice that can see or hear you gains {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} and has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls until the start of your next turn. The {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} gained are equal to {@dice 1d12} plus your Strength or Charisma modifier (minimum of +1). You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Strength or Charisma modifier (minimum of once), regaining all expended uses upon finishing a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

feat.name: Hill Giant's Brawn
entries: You possess the incredible might of a hill giant, pushing your limits beyond levels capable of typical Humanoids.

items: Your maximum Strength score increases by 2.

feat.name: Stone Giant's Reflex
entries: You possess the blistering reflexes and natural agility of a stone giant, granting you the following benefits.

items: When you are hit by a ranged attack roll that deals Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to reduce the damage you take from the attack by an amount equal to {@dice 1d8} plus your Dexterity modifier plus your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and if that damage is reduced to 0, you can redirect some of the attack's force. One creature you can see within 60 feet must succeed a Dexterity saving throw (DC = 8 + your Dexterity modifier + your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}) or take Force damage. The damage is equal to {@dice 1d8} plus your Dexterity modifier plus your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Dexterity modifier (minimum of once), regaining all expended uses upon finishing a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

feat.name: Cloud Giant's Gait
entries: You possess the fleet-footed magic of the Cloud Giants, granting you the following benefits:

items: Your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} increases by 5 feet.

When you take the {@action Dash|XPHB} or {@action Disengage|XPHB} actions, you can grant yourself a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} equal to half your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} until the end of the turn. If you are still airborne and unsupported at the end of the turn, you fall. You can use this feature a number of times equal to the modifier of the ability score you increased with this feat, regaining all expended uses upon finishing a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

feat.name: Fire Giant's Fury
entries: You possess the ferocious, burning magic of the Fire Giants, granting you the following benefits.

items: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can conjure an aura of flame that leaps from your body. Each time you hit a target with an attack roll this turn, the target takes an additional {@damage 1d6} Fire damage. You can use this feature once, regaining a use upon finishing a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

feat.name: Storm Giant's Thunderclap
entries: You possess the roiling, thunderous magic of the Storm Giants, granting you the following benefits:

items: When you score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} against a creature with a weapon attack or {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}, the target takes additional Lightning damage equal to your character level and is {@condition Blinded|XPHB} and {@condition Deafened|XPHB} until the end of its next turn.

spell.name: Fiery Step
entries: You teleport in a brilliant flash of flame. Roll {@dice 1d4} and take Fire damage equal to the result. You then teleport to an unoccupied space you can see a number of feet away equal to 5 x the Fire damage you received.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, roll

spell.name: Lesser Invisibility

components.m: a strand of hair encased in gum arabic

entries: When you cast this spell, and at the end of each of your turns for the duration, roll a {@dice d20}. On a roll of 11 or higher, you turn {@condition Invisible|XPHB} until the end of your next turn, or until you make an attack or cast a spell.

spell.name: Conjure Miner Elementals
entries: You conjure elemental dwarves, complete with helmets and pickaxes, which flit around you in a 15-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} for the duration. Until the spell ends, any attack you make deals an extra {@damage 1d8} damage when you hit a creature in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}, as a dwarf supplements the attack with a strike of its pickaxe. The dwarves also cause the ground in the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} to be {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} for your enemies.
Additionally, you have a 5-foot {@variantrule Burrow Speed|XPHB} for the duration, as the dwarves carve your path through the earth.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the extra damage increases by {@dice 1d8} for each slot level above 3rd.

spell.name: Raise Dad
entries: You magically project an illusion of a creature's father in the mind of a target within 60 feet. If the target is an ally, the illusion speaks words of encouragement; that creature gains a point of inspiration and has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws to resist or end the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition for 1 minute.

If the target is an enemy, it must succeed on a Wisdom save to avoid being scolded by the vision. On a fail, the creature has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

spell.name: Extremely Delayed Blast Fireball

components.m: a tiny ball of bat guano

entries: Choose a point within range. If you concentrate for the full duration of this spell: when the spell ends, an eruption of flame bursts from the chosen point. Each creature in a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on that point must make a Dexterity saving throw. A creature takes {@damage 8d6} Fire damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success. If your {@status Concentration|XPHB} ends early, the spell ends harmlessly and nothing happens.

While concentrating on this spell, your body sheds {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB|bright} crimson light in a 15-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} and you emit a piercing whistling noise audible up to 150 feet away.

spell.name: Monomorph
entries: This spell transforms your body into a new form. The first time you cast it, roll {@dice 1d6} on the Monomorph Transformations table. You transform into the resulting creature. Any time you subsequently cast this spell, you transform into that creature (do not roll again).

This transformation lasts for the duration, or until you drop to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} or die. Your game statistics, including mental ability scores, are replaced by the statistics of the creature. You retain your alignment and personality.

You assume the {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} of your new form. When you revert to your normal form, you return to the number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} you had before you transformed. If you revert as a result of dropping to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, any excess damage carries over to your normal form. As long as the excess damage doesn't reduce your normal form to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, you aren't knocked {@condition Unconscious|XPHB}.
You are limited in the actions you can perform by the nature of your new form. You can't cast spells, and you can't take any actions your new form would not allow.

Your gear melds into the new form, unless the GM deems it appropriate for your new form to wield it. You can't activate, use, wield, or otherwise benefit from any of your equipment that is melded into your new form. If the creature you transform into carries equipment in its stat block, that equipment appears as part of your transformation, but disappears immediately if parted from you or the spell ends.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: The first time you cast this spell, if you cast it using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, roll {@dice 1d8} on the monomorph transformations table. If you cast it using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, roll {@dice 1d10}. If you cast it using a 9th level spell, roll {@dice 1d12}.

spell.name: Lightning Quiver
entries: You weave a boon of lightning magic over your ammunition. For the duration, when you make a ranged attack roll, the weapon's ammunition, or the weapon itself if it's a thrown weapon, crackles with elemental energy, granting the following benefits.

items: That attack roll is made at {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} if it targets a creature wearing or made of metal.
The attack deals an additional {@damage 1d6} Lightning damage on a hit

entries: If you used a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to cast {@spell Hunter's Mark|XPHB} this turn, you can cast this spell in place of one attack when you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action. If you do, it is modified in the following ways:

items: It does not require {@status Concentration|XPHB}
It lasts for the full duration, or until you stop concentrating on {@spell Hunter's Mark|XPHB}
You have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Constitution saving throws made to maintain {@status Concentration|XPHB} on spells

spell.name: Transmutation Quiver
entries: You weave a boon of transmutation magic over your ammunition. For the duration, when you make a ranged attack roll, the weapon's ammunition, or the weapon itself if it's a thrown weapon, crackles with fey energy, granting the following benefits.

items: When you hit a creature, that target must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or be teleported up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see
After your attack hits or misses, the ammunition or the thrown weapon you used to attack vanishes, reappearing on your person.
As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} each turn, you can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

entries: If you used a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to cast {@spell Hunter's Mark|XPHB} this turn, you can cast this spell in place of one attack when you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action. If you do, it is modified in the following ways:

items: It does not require {@status Concentration|XPHB}
It lasts for the full duration, or until you stop concentrating on {@spell Hunter's Mark|XPHB}
You have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Constitution saving throws made to maintain {@status Concentration|XPHB} on spells

spell.name: Blade of Grass
entries: Up to two melee weapons you're holding become infused with nature, transforming into living, deadly plant matter. For the duration, when you attack with an infused weapon, you gain the following benefits:

items: You have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls
Your reach increases by 5 feet.

If you score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} against a creature, the target is {@condition Restrained|XPHB} for the next minute, as vines burst from the hilt of your infused weapon to ensnare it. An ensnared creature can use its action to attempt a Strength or Dexterity saving throw, escaping the vines on a success.

entries: If you used a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to cast {@spell Hunter's Mark|XPHB} this turn, you can cast this spell in place of one attack when you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action. If you do, it is modified in the following ways:

items: It does not require {@status Concentration|XPHB}
It lasts for the full duration, or until you stop concentrating on {@spell Hunter's Mark|XPHB}
You have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on Constitution saving throws made to maintain {@status Concentration|XPHB} on spells

spell.name: Corroding Pool
entries: A caustic pool of bubbling acid covers the ground in a 20-foot square centered on a point within range and turns it into {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} for the duration. The first time a creature enters or starts in the area on its turn, it must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 3d10} Acid damage on a failed save or half as much on a success. Medium or smaller nonmagical objects submerged in the acid are destroyed after 30 seconds.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the size of the square increases by 5 feet for each slot level above 3rd.

spell.name: Spirit of the Serpent
entries: A willing creature within range becomes imbued with the spirit of a serpent. Until the spell ends, the target can move at full {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} while {@condition Prone|XPHB}, melee attacks that target it while {@condition Prone|XPHB} cannot have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}, it ignores {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} imposed on weapon attack rolls and {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes} as a result of being {@condition Prone|XPHB}, and it gains {@sense Tremorsense|XPHB} out to 10 feet.

spell.name: Spirit of the Bear
entries: A willing creature within range becomes imbued with the spirit of a raging bear. Until the spell ends, the target resists all damage, except Psychic damage, it has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks that rely on smell, and its Strength-based weapon attack rolls and {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes} deal an additional {@damage 1d6} damage.

spell.name: Abyssal Blade
entries: You bind vicious threads of demonic magic into a ferocious weapon in your hand. The magic weapon lasts until the spell ends. It counts as a simple melee weapon with which you are proficient, with a value of 1 SP. You decide the weapon's form, choosing between a sword or whip. The sword has the {@itemProperty F|XPHB|Finesse} property and deals {@damage 3d4} Necrotic damage on a hit. The whip has the {@itemProperty F|XPHB|Finesse} and {@itemProperty R|XPHB|Reach} properties, and deals {@damage 1d4} Necrotic damage on a hit.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage increases by {@dice 2d4} for every two slot levels above 1st.

spell.name: Demonic Roulette
entries: Target four creatures you can see within range and assign each one a different number from 1-4. Roll {@dice 1d4}. The creature whose number is rolled takes {@damage 6d6} Necrotic damage as a swarm of spectral quasits erupt from the air around them and savagely strike before vanishing. Creatures whose numbers were not rolled each gain a point of {@variantrule Heroic Inspiration|XPHB}.

spell.name: Demonosis
entries: You attempt to infuse a creature within range with demonic energy. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (a willing creature can choose to fail) or undergo a demonic transformation. A transformed creature gains 15 {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB}, and until the spell ends, its speed increases by 10 feet, it is {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB|immune} to Poison damage, it has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on weapon attack rolls, attack rolls made against it have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB}, and once per turn, when it is hit by an attack roll, it explodes with poisonous energy, dealing {@damage 2d6} Poison damage to all creatures in a 10-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the number of {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} granted by the spell increases by 5 and the Poison damage increases by {@dice 1d6} for each slot level above 3rd.

spell.name: Word of The Demon Lord
entries: You direct a dreadful word of power towards a creature within range, invoking the wrath of a demon lord. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or {@damage 12d10} Psychic damage and become {@condition Frightened|XPHB} of you for the next minute. If the target of this spell is a demon, it automatically fails its saving throw, takes no damage, and is {@condition Charmed|XPHB} for the duration instead.

spell.name: Pummelling Strike
entries: You magically infuse the weapon used in this spell's casting with concussive energy and make an attack with it. On a hit, the target suffers the weapon attack's normal effects, and is pushed 10 feet directly away from you. If this movement causes the target to move into the space of another creature or a solid object (such as a wall or boulder), both the target and the creature/object it collides with take Bludgeoning damage equal to your spellcasting modifier.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: At 5th level, the weapon attack deals an extra {@damage 1d6} Bludgeoning damage to the target on a hit, and the damage dealt to creatures/objects who collide increases to {@damage 1d6} + your spellcasting modifier. Both damage rolls increase by {@dice 1d6} at 11th level ({@damage 2d6} and {@damage 2d6}) and 17th level ({@damage 3d6} and {@damage 3d6}).

spell.name: Guiding Strike
entries: You magically infuse the weapon used in this spell's casting with homing energy and make an attack with it, adding a bonus to your attack roll equal to your spellcasting modifier.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: At 5th level, gain an additional {@dice 1d4} bonus to your attack roll. This bonus increases to {@dice 2d4} at 11th level, and {@dice 3d4} at 17th.

spell.name: Borrowed Time
entries: With a gentle touch, you weave threads of chronomancy magic around a target, borrowing energy from a future point in a willing creature's life. That target can immediately expend a number of hit dice up to twice the level of the spell slot you expend to cast this spell. It loses points of {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} equal to the number hit dice expended, and then rolls the expended dice and gains {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the total + your spellcasting modifier.
When the spell ends, any remaining {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} vanish and the target regains all points of {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} that were removed by this spell.

spell.name: Explosion
entries: A series of thundering explosions burst from your body, reverberating out in a 20-foot radius. Creatures in that area make a Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 3d10} Force damage and {@damage 3d10} Thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success. You have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on saving throws made to avoid the damage of this spell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or above, the Force damage increases by {@dice 1d10} for each level above 3rd.

spell.name: Poison Sting
entries: You deliver a venomous, stinging jab. Make a melee spell attack against a target within reach, dealing {@damage 1d10} Poison damage on a hit. If you roll a 1 or 2 on any damage die rolled as part of the attack, the target is also {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} for the next minute. A creature {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} in this way makes a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: This spell's damage increases by {@dice 1d10} when you reach 5th level ({@damage 2d10}), 11th level ({@damage 3d10}), and 17th level ({@damage 4d10}).

spell.name: Dragon Dance
entries: You perform a powerful, magically infused dance. Your movement speed increases by 10 feet and you gain a +1 bonus to damage rolls for the spell's duration. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on subsequent turns, you can repeat this dance as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, granting a further speed increase of 10 feet and an additional +1 to damage rolls.
Dragon Dance can grant a maximum bonus to your damage rolls equal to the level of the spell slot used to cast it.

spell.name: Leech Seed
entries: A swarm of magical seeds burst from your outstretched palm toward a creature within range. The target makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a fail, the seeds burrow into its body and form a magical, parasitic connection. At the end of each of your turns, the target takes {@damage 1d10} Necrotic damage, and you regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the damage dealt.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: The Necrotic damage increases by {@dice 1d10} for each spell slot level above 1st.

spell.name: Light Screen
entries: You create a wall of shimmering golden light on a solid surface within range. You can make the wall up to 60 feet long, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick, or a ringed wall up to 20 feet in diameter, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick. The wall is translucent and lasts for the duration.

One side of the wall, selected by you when you cast this spell, is fortified with abjuration magic. Creatures that would take damage from a spell or magical effect that originates outside the fortified side of the wall have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to that damage.

spell.name: Reflect
entries: You create a wall of shimmering silver light on a solid surface within range. You can make the wall up to 60 feet long, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick, or a ringed wall up to 20 feet in diameter, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick. The wall is translucent and lasts for the duration.

One side of the wall, selected by you when you cast this spell, is fortified with abjuration magic. Creatures targeted by a weapon attack roll that passes through the wall, entering through the fortified side, have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to the damage from that attack. Any creatures that take damage from projectiles or objects (such as falling rocks) that pass through the wall, entering through the fortified side, have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to that damage.

spell.name: Aurora Veil
entries: You create a wall of shimmering blue light on a solid surface within range. You can make the wall up to 60 feet long, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick, or a ringed wall up to 20 feet in diameter, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick. The wall is translucent and lasts for the duration.

One side of the wall, selected by you when you cast this spell, is fortified with abjuration magic. All creatures have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to any source of damage that enters the wall through the fortified side first.

spell.name: Abjurer's Bane
entries: You hurl a word of psionic power that cleaves towards a creature you can see within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes {@damage 3d12} Psychic damage.

The target of this spell cannot take {@variantrule Reaction|XPHBs} in response to its casting, and creatures with {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} have {@variantrule Vulnerability|XPHB} to the damage dealt by this spell.

entriesHigherLevel.name: At Higher Levels
entries: If you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the damage dealt increases by {@dice 1d12} for each slot level above 2nd

spell.name: Earth's Pledge
entries: At your touch, a willing creature becomes blessed with the power of the earth. The target gains {@sense Tremorsense|XPHB} out to 30 feet, and can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} each turn to force one creature within 30 feet of it that is on the ground to make a Dexterity saving throw (use your Spell Save DC). On a fail, the target falls {@condition Prone|XPHB}.

spell.name: Air's Pledge
entries: At your touch, a willing creature becomes blessed with the power of the air.
